quiz.q: What does Miss Bingley's letter say?
o: They are all going to London and may not return
quiz.why_uz: Elizabet bu xat opa-singillarning hiylasi ekanini sezadi.

quiz.q: How does Elizabeth explain Bingley's departure?
o: His sisters and Darcy want to separate him from Jane
quiz.why_uz: U to'g'ri taxmin qiladi.

chapters.title: Charlotte's Choice
chapters.recap_uz: Kollinz Sharlotta Lukasga taklif qiladi va u rozi bo'ladi. Sharlotta: «Men romantik emasman, menga faqat qulay uy kerak», deydi. Elizabet hayratda qoladi.

paras.en: The Bennets were engaged to dine with the Lucases and again during the chief of the day was Miss Lucas so kind as to listen to Mr. Collins. Elizabeth took an opportunity of thanking her. “It keeps him in good humour,” said she, “and I am more obliged to you than I can express.” Charlotte assured her friend of her satisfaction in being useful, and that it amply repaid her for the little sacrifice of her time. This was very amiable, but Charlotte's kindness extended farther than Elizabeth had any conception of; its object was nothing else than to secure her from any return of Mr. Collins's addresses, by engaging them towards herself. Such was Miss Lucas's scheme; and appearances were so favourable, that when they parted at night, she would have felt almost secure of success if he had not been to leave Hertfordshire so very soon.
paras.uz: Bennetlar Lukaslarnikiga tushlikka taklif qilingan edi va kunning asosiy qismida miss Lukas yana janob Kollinzni tinglashga mehribonlik ko'rsatdi. Elizabet unga rahmat aytish imkoniyatini topdi. «Bu uning kayfiyatini yaxshi saqlaydi, — dedi u, — va men senga ifodalab bo'lmaydigan darajada minnatdorman». Sharlotta dugonasini foydali bo'lishdan mamnunligiga va bu vaqtining kichik qurbonligini mo'l-ko'l qoplashiga ishontirdi. Bu juda yoqimli edi, lekin Sharlottaning mehribonligi Elizabet tasavvur qilganidan ham uzoqroqqa borardi; uning maqsadi janob Kollinzning murojaatlarini o'ziga qaratish orqali dugonasini ularning qaytalanishidan himoya qilishdan boshqa narsa emasdi. Miss Lukasning rejasi shunday edi; vaziyat shunchalik qulay ediki, kechqurun ajralishganda, agar u Xertfordshirni bunchalik tez tark etmasligi kerak bo'lganida, u muvaffaqiyatga deyarli ishonch hosil qilgan bo'lardi.

paras.en: But here she did injustice to the fire and independence of his character, for it led him to escape out of Longbourn House the next morning with admirable slyness, and hasten to Lucas Lodge to throw himself at her feet. He was anxious to avoid the notice of his cousins, from a conviction that if they saw him depart, they could not fail to conjecture his design, and he was not willing to have the attempt known till its success might be known likewise; for though feeling almost secure, and with reason, for Charlotte had been tolerably encouraging, he was comparatively diffident since the adventure of Wednesday. His reception, however, was of the most flattering kind. Miss Lucas perceived him from an upper window as he walked towards the house, and instantly set out to meet him accidentally in the lane.
paras.uz: Lekin bu yerda u uning xarakterining olovi va mustaqilligiga nohaqlik qildi, chunki bu uni ertasi kuni ertalab ajoyib ayyorlik bilan Longborn uyidan sirg'alib chiqib, uning oyoqlariga o'zini tashlash uchun Lukas Lojga shoshilishga undadi. U amakivachchalarining e'tiboridan qochishga intildi, chunki agar ular uning ketayotganini ko'rsalar, niyatini taxmin qilmay qolmasliklariga ishonardi va urinishi haqida uning muvaffaqiyati ham ma'lum bo'lmaguncha bilishlarini istamasdi; chunki u deyarli ishonch hosil qilgan bo'lsa ham — va asos bilan, chunki Sharlotta ancha rag'batlantirgan edi — chorshanba kungi sarguzashtdan beri nisbatan tortinchoq edi. Biroq uni eng xushomadli tarzda kutib olishdi. Miss Lukas uni uyga qarab kelayotganida yuqori derazadan ko'rdi va darhol u bilan tor ko'chada tasodifan uchrashish uchun yo'lga chiqdi.

paras.en: But little had she dared to hope that so much love and eloquence awaited her there.
paras.uz: Lekin u yerda uni bunchalik ko'p muhabbat va notiqlik kutayotganiga umid qilishga zo'rg'a jur'at etgan edi.

paras.en: In as short a time as Mr. Collins's long speeches would allow, everything was settled between them to the satisfaction of both; and as they entered the house he earnestly entreated her to name the day that was to make him the happiest of men; and though such a solicitation must be waived for the present, the lady felt no inclination to trifle with his happiness. The stupidity with which he was favoured by nature must guard his courtship from any charm that could make a woman wish for its continuance; and Miss Lucas, who accepted him solely from the pure and disinterested desire of an establishment, cared not how soon that establishment were gained.
paras.uz: Janob Kollinzning uzun nutqlari imkon bergan qisqa vaqt ichida ular o'rtasida hamma narsa ikkalasining ham qoniqishiga hal qilindi; uyga kirishganda u uni eng baxtli erkakka aylantiradigan kunni belgilashni astoydil iltimos qildi; garchi bunday iltimosni hozircha keyinga qoldirish kerak bo'lsa ham, xonim uning baxti bilan o'ynashga hech qanday moyillik sezmadi. Tabiat uni siylagan ahmoqlik uning sovchiligini ayolda uning davom etishini istashga undaydigan har qanday jozibadan himoya qilishi kerak edi; uni faqat uy-joyli bo'lishning sof va beg'araz istagi bilan qabul qilgan miss Lukas esa bu uy-joyga qanchalik tez erishishiga ahamiyat bermasdi.

paras.en: Sir William and Lady Lucas were speedily applied to for their consent; and it was bestowed with a most joyful alacrity. Mr. Collins's present circumstances made it a most eligible match for their daughter, to whom they could give little fortune; and his prospects of future wealth were exceedingly fair. Lady Lucas began directly to calculate, with more interest than the matter had ever excited before, how many years longer Mr. Bennet was likely to live; and Sir William gave it as his decided opinion, that whenever Mr. Collins should be in possession of the Longbourn estate, it would be highly expedient that both he and his wife should make their appearance at St. James's. The whole family, in short, were properly overjoyed on the occasion.
paras.uz: Ser Uilyam va ledi Lukasdan rozilik so'rashga shoshilishdi; u eng quvonchli tayyorlik bilan berildi. Janob Kollinzning hozirgi ahvoli uni katta sep bera olmaydigan qizlari uchun eng munosib kuyovga aylantirardi; uning kelajakdagi boylik istiqboli esa nihoyatda yaxshi edi. Ledi Lukas darhol bu masala hech qachon uyg'otmagan qiziqish bilan janob Bennet yana necha yil yashashi mumkinligini hisoblay boshladi; ser Uilyam esa janob Kollinz Longborn mulkiga egalik qilgan zahoti u ham, xotini ham Sent-Jeyms saroyida paydo bo'lishlari juda maqsadga muvofiq bo'lishi haqida qat'iy fikr bildirdi. Qisqasi, butun oila bu munosabat bilan munosib darajada xursand edi.

paras.en: The younger girls formed hopes of coming out a year or two sooner than they might otherwise have done; and the boys were relieved from their apprehension of Charlotte's dying an old maid. Charlotte herself was tolerably composed. She had gained her point, and had time to consider of it. Her reflections were in general satisfactory. Mr. Collins, to be sure, was neither sensible nor agreeable; his society was irksome, and his attachment to her must be imaginary. But still he would be her husband. Without thinking highly either of men or matrimony, marriage had always been her object; it was the only provision for well-educated young women of small fortune, and however uncertain of giving happiness, must be their pleasantest preservative from want. This preservative she had now obtained; and at the age of twenty-seven, without having ever been handsome, she felt all the good luck of it.
paras.uz: Kichik qizlar aks holda bo'lishi mumkin bo'lganidan bir-ikki yil oldinroq jamiyatga chiqish umidini qilishdi; o'g'il bolalar esa Sharlotta qari qiz bo'lib o'lib ketishi haqidagi qo'rquvlaridan qutulishdi. Sharlottaning o'zi ancha xotirjam edi. U maqsadiga erishgan va bu haqda o'ylashga vaqti bor edi. Uning mulohazalari umuman qoniqarli edi. Janob Kollinz, albatta, na aqlli, na yoqimli edi; uning davrasi zerikarli, unga bo'lgan mehri esa xayoliy bo'lishi kerak edi. Lekin baribir u uning eri bo'ladi. Erkaklar haqida ham, nikoh haqida ham yuqori fikrda bo'lmasa ham, turmush qurish doim uning maqsadi bo'lgan; bu kichik sepli yaxshi tarbiyalangan yosh ayollar uchun yagona ta'minot edi va baxt berishi qanchalik noaniq bo'lmasin, muhtojlikdan eng yoqimli himoya bo'lishi kerak edi. Bu himoyaga u endi erishgan edi; va yigirma yetti yoshda, hech qachon chiroyli bo'lmagan holda, u buning butun omadini his qildi.

paras.en: The least agreeable circumstance in the business was the surprise it must occasion to Elizabeth Bennet, whose friendship she valued beyond that of any other person. Elizabeth would wonder, and probably would blame her; and though her resolution was not to be shaken, her feelings must be hurt by such a disapprobation. She resolved to give her the information herself, and therefore charged Mr. Collins, when he returned to Longbourn to dinner, to drop no hint of what had passed before any of the family. A promise of secrecy was of course very dutifully given, but it could not be kept without difficulty; for the curiosity excited by his long absence burst forth in such very direct questions on his return as required some ingenuity to evade, and he was at the same time exercising great self-denial, for he was longing to publish his prosperous love.
paras.uz: Bu ishdagi eng yoqimsiz holat bu Elizabet Bennetda uyg'otishi kerak bo'lgan hayrat edi, uning do'stligini u boshqa har qanday odamnikidan ortiq qadrlardi. Elizabet hayron qoladi va, ehtimol, uni ayblaydi; garchi qarori qat'iy bo'lsa ham, bunday norozilik uning tuyg'ularini ranjitishi muqarrar edi. U xabarni unga o'zi aytishga qaror qildi va shuning uchun janob Kollinzga Longbornga tushlikka qaytganida oila a'zolarining hech biri oldida bo'lib o'tgan voqea haqida ishora ham qilmaslikni topshirdi. Sir saqlash va'dasi, albatta, juda itoatkorona berildi, lekin uni qiyinchiliksiz saqlab bo'lmasdi; chunki uning uzoq yo'qligi uyg'otgan qiziqish qaytganida shunday to'g'ridan-to'g'ri savollar bilan portladiki, ulardan qochish biroz zukkolikni talab qildi, shu bilan birga u o'zini juda tiyishga majbur edi, chunki baxtli muhabbatini e'lon qilishni juda istardi.

paras.en: As he was to begin his journey too early on the morrow to see any of the family, the ceremony of leave-taking was performed when the ladies moved for the night; and Mrs. Bennet, with great politeness and cordiality, said how happy they should be to see him at Longbourn again, whenever his engagements might allow him to visit them.
paras.uz: U ertasi kuni oila a'zolaridan birortasini ko'rish uchun haddan tashqari erta yo'lga chiqishi kerak bo'lgani uchun, xayrlashish marosimi xonimlar tunga ketishayotganda bajarildi; missis Bennet katta xushmuomalalik va samimiyat bilan uning ishlari ularga tashrif buyurishga imkon bergan har qanday vaqtda uni yana Longbornda ko'rishdan qanchalik baxtli bo'lishlarini aytdi.

paras.en: “My dear madam,” he replied, “this invitation is particularly gratifying, because it is what I have been hoping to receive; and you may be very certain that I shall avail myself of it as soon as possible.”
paras.uz: «Aziz xonim, — javob berdi u, — bu taklif ayniqsa yoqimli, chunki aynan uni olishga umid qilgan edim; va ishonchingiz komil bo'lishi mumkinki, iloji boricha tezroq undan foydalanaman».

paras.en: They were all astonished; and Mr. Bennet, who could by no means wish for so speedy a return, immediately said:
paras.uz: Hammalari hayratda qolishdi; bunchalik tez qaytishini umuman istamagan janob Bennet esa darhol dedi:

paras.en: “But is there not danger of Lady Catherine's disapprobation here, my good sir? You had better neglect your relations than run the risk of offending your patroness.”
paras.uz: «Lekin bu yerda ledi Ketrinning noroziligi xavfi yo'qmi, aziz ser? Homiyangizni ranjitish xavfini tug'dirgandan ko'ra, qarindoshlaringizni e'tiborsiz qoldirganingiz ma'qul».

paras.en: “My dear sir,” replied Mr. Collins, “I am particularly obliged to you for this friendly caution, and you may depend upon my not taking so material a step without her ladyship's concurrence.”
paras.uz: «Aziz ser, — javob berdi janob Kollinz, — bu do'stona ogohlantirishingiz uchun sizdan ayniqsa minnatdorman va ishonishingiz mumkinki, janoblarining roziligisiz bunday muhim qadamni tashlamayman».

paras.en: “You cannot be too much upon your guard. Risk anything rather than her displeasure; and if you find it likely to be raised by your coming to us again, which I should think exceedingly probable, stay quietly at home, and be satisfied that we shall take no offence.”
paras.uz: «Haddan tashqari ehtiyot bo'lishning iloji yo'q. Uning noroziligidan ko'ra har qanday narsani xavf ostiga qo'ying; va agar uni bizga yana kelishingiz qo'zg'atishi mumkinligini sezsangiz — menimcha, bu juda ehtimol — uyda tinchgina qoling va biz ranjimasligimizga ishoning».

paras.en: “Believe me, my dear sir, my gratitude is warmly excited by such affectionate attention; and depend upon it, you will speedily receive from me a letter of thanks for this, and for every other mark of your regard during my stay in Hertfordshire. As for my fair cousins, though my absence may not be long enough to render it necessary, I shall now take the liberty of wishing them health and happiness, not excepting my cousin Elizabeth.”
paras.uz: «Ishoning, aziz ser, bunday mehrli e'tibor minnatdorligimni qizg'in uyg'otadi; va ishonavering, tez orada mendan buning uchun ham, Xertfordshirda bo'lgan vaqtimda ko'rsatgan boshqa har bir hurmatingiz uchun ham minnatdorchilik xati olasiz. Go'zal amakivachchalarimga kelsak, garchi yo'qligim buni zarur qiladigan darajada uzoq bo'lmasa ham, endi ularga, amakivachcham Elizabetni ham istisno qilmay, sog'lik va baxt tilashga ijozat olaman».

paras.en: With proper civilities the ladies then withdrew; all of them equally surprised that he meditated a quick return. Mrs. Bennet wished to understand by it that he thought of paying his addresses to one of her younger girls, and Mary might have been prevailed on to accept him. She rated his abilities much higher than any of the others; there was a solidity in his reflections which often struck her, and though by no means so clever as herself, she thought that if encouraged to read and improve himself by such an example as hers, he might become a very agreeable companion. But on the following morning, every hope of this kind was done away. Miss Lucas called soon after breakfast, and in a private conference with Elizabeth related the event of the day before.
paras.uz: Shundan keyin xonimlar munosib xushmuomalalik bilan chiqib ketishdi; hammalari uning tez qaytishni o'ylayotganidan bir xil hayratda edi. Missis Bennet buni u kichik qizlaridan biriga sovchi qo'ymoqchi ekan deb tushunishni xohladi va Merini uni qabul qilishga ko'ndirish mumkin edi. U uning qobiliyatlarini boshqalarning hammasidan ancha yuqori baholardi; uning mulohazalarida uni tez-tez hayratga soladigan salmoqlilik bor edi va garchi u o'zidek aqlli bo'lmasa ham, agar uni o'zinikidek misol bilan o'qishga va o'zini takomillashtirishga rag'batlantirilsa, u juda yoqimli hamroh bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'ylardi. Lekin ertasi kuni ertalab bunday har qanday umid yo'qqa chiqdi. Miss Lukas nonushtadan ko'p o'tmay keldi va Elizabet bilan xususiy suhbatda kechagi voqeani aytib berdi.

paras.en: The possibility of Mr. Collins's fancying himself in love with her friend had once occurred to Elizabeth within the last day or two; but that Charlotte could encourage him seemed almost as far from possibility as she could encourage him herself, and her astonishment was consequently so great as to overcome at first the bounds of decorum, and she could not help crying out:
paras.uz: Janob Kollinz o'zini dugonasiga oshiq deb tasavvur qilishi ehtimoli so'nggi bir-ikki kun ichida Elizabetning xayoliga bir marta kelgan edi; lekin Sharlotta uni rag'batlantirishi unga o'zi uni rag'batlantirishi kabi deyarli imkonsiz tuyulardi va shuning uchun uning hayrati shunchalik katta ediki, avvaliga odob chegaralaridan oshib ketdi va u qichqirib yubormay qololmadi:

paras.en: “Engaged to Mr. Collins! My dear Charlotte--impossible!”
paras.uz: «Janob Kollinzga unashtirildingmi! Azizim Sharlotta — imkonsiz!»

paras.en: The steady countenance which Miss Lucas had commanded in telling her story, gave way to a momentary confusion here on receiving so direct a reproach; though, as it was no more than she expected, she soon regained her composure, and calmly replied:
paras.uz: Miss Lukasning hikoyasini aytayotganda saqlagan barqaror chehrasi bunday to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ta'nani eshitib, bir lahzalik sarosimaga o'rin berdi; biroq bu u kutganidan ortiq bo'lmagani uchun, tez orada xotirjamligini tikladi va sokin javob berdi:

paras.en: “Why should you be surprised, my dear Eliza? Do you think it incredible that Mr. Collins should be able to procure any woman's good opinion, because he was not so happy as to succeed with you?”
paras.uz: «Nega hayron bo'lishing kerak, azizim Eliza? Janob Kollinz sen bilan muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmagani uchun biror ayolning yaxshi fikriga sazovor bo'la olishini aqlga sig'maydigan narsa deb o'ylaysanmi?»

paras.en: But Elizabeth had now recollected herself, and making a strong effort for it, was able to assure with tolerable firmness that the prospect of their relationship was highly grateful to her, and that she wished her all imaginable happiness.
paras.uz: Lekin Elizabet endi o'zini tutib olgan edi va kuchli harakat qilib, ancha qat'iyat bilan ularning qarindosh bo'lish istiqboli unga juda yoqimli ekanini va unga tasavvur qilish mumkin bo'lgan barcha baxtni tilashini ayta oldi.

paras.en: “I see what you are feeling,” replied Charlotte. “You must be surprised, very much surprised--so lately as Mr. Collins was wishing to marry you. But when you have had time to think it over, I hope you will be satisfied with what I have done. I am not romantic, you know; I never was. I ask only a comfortable home; and considering Mr. Collins's character, connection, and situation in life, I am convinced that my chance of happiness with him is as fair as most people can boast on entering the marriage state.”
paras.uz: «Nimani his qilayotganingni ko'ryapman, — javob berdi Sharlotta. — Sen hayron bo'lishing kerak, juda hayron — axir janob Kollinz yaqindagina senga uylanmoqchi edi. Lekin buni o'ylab ko'rishga vaqting bo'lgach, umid qilamanki, qilgan ishimdan qoniqasan. Bilasan, men romantik emasman; hech qachon bo'lmaganman. Men faqat qulay uy so'rayman; janob Kollinzning xarakteri, aloqalari va hayotdagi mavqeini hisobga olsam, u bilan baxtli bo'lish imkoniyatim nikohga kirayotgan ko'pchilik odamlar maqtana oladigan darajada yaxshi ekaniga aminman».

paras.en: Elizabeth quietly answered “Undoubtedly;” and after an awkward pause, they returned to the rest of the family. Charlotte did not stay much longer, and Elizabeth was then left to reflect on what she had heard. It was a long time before she became at all reconciled to the idea of so unsuitable a match. The strangeness of Mr. Collins's making two offers of marriage within three days was nothing in comparison of his being now accepted. She had always felt that Charlotte's opinion of matrimony was not exactly like her own, but she had not supposed it to be possible that, when called into action, she would have sacrificed every better feeling to worldly advantage. Charlotte the wife of Mr. Collins was a most humiliating picture! And to the pang of a friend disgracing herself and sunk in her esteem, was added the distressing conviction that it was impossible for that friend to be tolerably happy in the lot she had chosen.
paras.uz: Elizabet jimgina «Shubhasiz» deb javob berdi; noqulay sukutdan keyin ular oilaning qolgan a'zolari oldiga qaytishdi. Sharlotta ko'p qolmadi va keyin Elizabet eshitganlari haqida o'ylash uchun yolg'iz qoldi. U bunday nomunosib nikoh fikri bilan umuman murosaga kelishi uchun ancha vaqt kerak bo'ldi. Janob Kollinzning uch kun ichida ikki marta nikoh taklif qilishining g'alatiligi endi uning qabul qilinganiga nisbatan hech narsa emasdi. U doim Sharlottaning nikoh haqidagi fikri o'zinikiga aynan o'xshash emasligini his qilgan edi, lekin harakatga kelganda u har qanday yaxshiroq tuyg'uni dunyoviy manfaatga qurbon qilishi mumkinligini taxmin qilmagan edi. Janob Kollinzning xotini Sharlotta — eng kamsituvchi manzara edi! Va o'zini sharmanda qilgan va uning nazarida pastga tushgan dugona uchun og'riqqa o'sha dugona o'zi tanlagan taqdirda ozgina bo'lsa ham baxtli bo'lishi imkonsiz ekaniga bo'lgan azobli ishonch qo'shildi.

o: She wants a comfortable home and security
quiz.why_uz: Sharlotta 27 yoshda, kambag'al va unga boshqa imkoniyat kam.

chapters.title: Mrs. Bennet's Despair
chapters.recap_uz: Ser Uilyam Lukas Sharlottaning nikohini e'lon qiladi. Missis Bennet g'azablanadi. Bingleydan xabar yo'q; Jeyn jim azob chekadi.

paras.en: Elizabeth was sitting with her mother and sisters, reflecting on what she had heard, and doubting whether she was authorised to mention it, when Sir William Lucas himself appeared, sent by his daughter, to announce her engagement to the family. With many compliments to them, and much self-gratulation on the prospect of a connection between the houses, he unfolded the matter--to an audience not merely wondering, but incredulous; for Mrs. Bennet, with more perseverance than politeness, protested he must be entirely mistaken; and Lydia, always unguarded and often uncivil, boisterously exclaimed:
paras.uz: Elizabet onasi va opa-singillari bilan o'tirib, eshitganlari haqida o'ylar va bu haqda gapirishga haqqi bormi, deb ikkilanardi, shu payt qizi yuborgan ser Uilyam Lukasning o'zi oilaga uning unashtirilganini e'lon qilish uchun paydo bo'ldi. Ularga ko'p iltifotlar qilib va xonadonlar o'rtasidagi qarindoshlik istiqboli bilan o'zini ko'p tabriklab, u masalani ochib berdi — nafaqat hayron, balki ishonmayotgan tinglovchilarga; chunki missis Bennet xushmuomalalikdan ko'ra ko'proq qat'iyat bilan uning butunlay adashayotgan bo'lishi kerakligini ta'kidladi; doim ehtiyotsiz va ko'pincha qo'pol Lidiya esa shovqin bilan xitob qildi:

paras.en: “Good Lord! Sir William, how can you tell such a story? Do not you know that Mr. Collins wants to marry Lizzy?”
paras.uz: «Yo xudo! Ser Uilyam, qanday qilib bunday gap to'qiy olasiz? Janob Kollinz Lizziga uylanmoqchi ekanini bilmaysizmi?»

paras.en: Nothing less than the complaisance of a courtier could have borne without anger such treatment; but Sir William's good breeding carried him through it all; and though he begged leave to be positive as to the truth of his information, he listened to all their impertinence with the most forbearing courtesy.
paras.uz: Saroy ahlining xushmuomalaligidan kamroq narsa bunday munosabatga g'azablanmasdan chiday olmasdi; lekin ser Uilyamning yaxshi tarbiyasi uni bularning hammasidan olib o'tdi; garchi u xabarining to'g'riligiga qat'iy turishga ruxsat so'ragan bo'lsa ham, ularning barcha surbetliklarini eng sabrli xushmuomalalik bilan tingladi.

paras.en: Elizabeth, feeling it incumbent on her to relieve him from so unpleasant a situation, now put herself forward to confirm his account, by mentioning her prior knowledge of it from Charlotte herself; and endeavoured to put a stop to the exclamations of her mother and sisters by the earnestness of her congratulations to Sir William, in which she was readily joined by Jane, and by making a variety of remarks on the happiness that might be expected from the match, the excellent character of Mr. Collins, and the convenient distance of Hunsford from London.
paras.uz: Elizabet uni bunday yoqimsiz vaziyatdan qutqarishni o'z burchi deb his qilib, endi oldinga chiqdi va bu haqda Sharlottaning o'zidan oldinroq bilganini aytib, uning hikoyasini tasdiqladi; va ser Uilyamni astoydil tabriklash bilan — bunda Jeyn ham darhol unga qo'shildi — hamda nikohdan kutilishi mumkin bo'lgan baxt, janob Kollinzning ajoyib xarakteri va Xansfordning Londondan qulay masofada ekani haqida turli gaplar aytib, onasi va opa-singillarining xitoblarini to'xtatishga urindi.

paras.en: Mrs. Bennet was in fact too much overpowered to say a great deal while Sir William remained; but no sooner had he left them than her feelings found a rapid vent. In the first place, she persisted in disbelieving the whole of the matter; secondly, she was very sure that Mr. Collins had been taken in; thirdly, she trusted that they would never be happy together; and fourthly, that the match might be broken off. Two inferences, however, were plainly deduced from the whole: one, that Elizabeth was the real cause of the mischief; and the other that she herself had been barbarously misused by them all; and on these two points she principally dwelt during the rest of the day. Nothing could console and nothing could appease her. Nor did that day wear out her resentment. A week elapsed before she could see Elizabeth without scolding her, a month passed away before she could speak to Sir William or Lady Lucas without being rude, and many months were gone before she could at all forgive their daughter.
paras.uz: Aslida missis Bennet ser Uilyam qolgan vaqtda ko'p gapira olmaslik darajada esankirab qolgan edi; lekin u ketishi bilanoq uning tuyg'ulari tez yo'l topdi. Birinchidan, u butun masalaga ishonmaslikda davom etdi; ikkinchidan, janob Kollinzni aldashganiga juda amin edi; uchinchidan, ular hech qachon birga baxtli bo'lmasligiga ishondi; to'rtinchidan esa, nikoh buzilishi mumkinligiga. Biroq bularning hammasidan ikki xulosa aniq kelib chiqdi: biri, Elizabet bu ko'ngilsizlikning haqiqiy sababchisi; ikkinchisi esa, ularning hammasi o'ziga vahshiylarcha yomon munosabatda bo'lgan; va kunning qolgan qismida u asosan shu ikki nuqtada to'xtaldi. Uni hech narsa yupata olmasdi va hech narsa tinchlantira olmasdi. O'sha kun ham uning ranjishini yo'qotmadi. Elizabetni koyimasdan ko'ra olishi uchun bir hafta o'tdi, ser Uilyam yoki ledi Lukas bilan qo'pollik qilmasdan gaplasha olishi uchun bir oy o'tdi, ularning qizini umuman kechira olishi uchun esa ko'p oylar o'tdi.

paras.en: Mr. Bennet's emotions were much more tranquil on the occasion, and such as he did experience he pronounced to be of a most agreeable sort; for it gratified him, he said, to discover that Charlotte Lucas, whom he had been used to think tolerably sensible, was as foolish as his wife, and more foolish than his daughter!
paras.uz: Bu munosabat bilan janob Bennetning tuyg'ulari ancha sokinroq edi va his qilganlarini u eng yoqimli turdagi tuyg'ular deb e'lon qildi; chunki, uning aytishicha, u ancha aqlli deb o'ylashga odatlangan Sharlotta Lukas xotini kabi ahmoq va qizidan ham ahmoqroq ekanini kashf qilish unga zavq bag'ishladi!

paras.en: Jane confessed herself a little surprised at the match; but she said less of her astonishment than of her earnest desire for their happiness; nor could Elizabeth persuade her to consider it as improbable. Kitty and Lydia were far from envying Miss Lucas, for Mr. Collins was only a clergyman; and it affected them in no other way than as a piece of news to spread at Meryton.
paras.uz: Jeyn bu nikohdan biroz hayron bo'lganini tan oldi; lekin u hayrati haqida ularning baxtli bo'lishiga bo'lgan chin istagidan kamroq gapirdi; Elizabet ham uni buni ehtimoldan yiroq deb hisoblashga ko'ndira olmadi. Ketti va Lidiya miss Lukasga hasad qilishdan yiroq edi, chunki janob Kollinz shunchaki ruhoniy edi; bu ularga Meritonda tarqatiladigan yangilik sifatida ta'sir qilganidan boshqa hech qanday ta'sir qilmadi.

paras.en: Lady Lucas could not be insensible of triumph on being able to retort on Mrs. Bennet the comfort of having a daughter well married; and she called at Longbourn rather oftener than usual to say how happy she was, though Mrs. Bennet's sour looks and ill-natured remarks might have been enough to drive happiness away.
paras.uz: Ledi Lukas missis Bennetga qizini yaxshi turmushga berish taskinini qaytara olganidan g'alaba hissini sezmay qololmadi; u qanchalik baxtli ekanini aytish uchun Longbornga odatdagidan ko'proq kelardi, garchi missis Bennetning nordon qarashlari va g'arazli gaplari baxtni haydab yuborishga yetarli bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa ham.

paras.en: Between Elizabeth and Charlotte there was a restraint which kept them mutually silent on the subject; and Elizabeth felt persuaded that no real confidence could ever subsist between them again. Her disappointment in Charlotte made her turn with fonder regard to her sister, of whose rectitude and delicacy she was sure her opinion could never be shaken, and for whose happiness she grew daily more anxious, as Bingley had now been gone a week and nothing more was heard of his return.
paras.uz: Elizabet bilan Sharlotta o'rtasida bir tortinish bor edi, u ikkalasini bu mavzuda jim turishga majbur qilardi; Elizabet ular o'rtasida endi hech qachon haqiqiy ishonch bo'lmasligiga amin edi. Sharlottadan hafsalasi pir bo'lgani uni opasiga yanada mehrliroq e'tibor bilan qaratdi, uning to'g'riligi va nozikligi haqidagi fikri hech qachon chayqalmasligiga amin edi va uning baxti uchun kundan-kunga ko'proq tashvishlanardi, chunki Bingli ketganiga bir hafta bo'lgan va uning qaytishi haqida boshqa hech narsa eshitilmagan edi.

paras.en: Jane had sent Caroline an early answer to her letter, and was counting the days till she might reasonably hope to hear again. The promised letter of thanks from Mr. Collins arrived on Tuesday, addressed to their father, and written with all the solemnity of gratitude which a twelvemonth's abode in the family might have prompted. After discharging his conscience on that head, he proceeded to inform them, with many rapturous expressions, of his happiness in having obtained the affection of their amiable neighbour, Miss Lucas, and then explained that it was merely with the view of enjoying her society that he had been so ready to close with their kind wish of seeing him again at Longbourn, whither he hoped to be able to return on Monday fortnight; for Lady Catherine, he added, so heartily approved his marriage, that she wished it to take place as soon as possible, which he trusted would be an unanswerable argument with his amiable Charlotte to name an early day for making him the happiest of men.
paras.uz: Jeyn Kerolaynga xatiga erta javob yuborgan edi va yana xat olishga asosli umid qila oladigan kungacha kunlarni sanardi. Janob Kollinzning va'da qilingan minnatdorchilik xati seshanba kuni keldi, u ularning otasiga yozilgan bo'lib, oilada bir yil yashash uyg'otishi mumkin bo'lgan minnatdorlikning butun salobati bilan yozilgan edi. Bu borada vijdonini tinchitgach, u ko'plab hayajonli iboralar bilan ularning yoqimli qo'shnisi miss Lukasning mehrini qozonganidagi baxti haqida xabar berishga o'tdi va keyin ularning uni yana Longbornda ko'rish haqidagi mehribon istagini shunchalik tez qabul qilgani faqat uning davrasidan bahramand bo'lish niyatida bo'lganini tushuntirdi; u ikki haftadan keyingi dushanba kuni u yerga qaytishga umid qilardi; chunki, qo'shib qo'ydi u, ledi Ketrin uning nikohini shunchalik chin dildan ma'qulladiki, u iloji boricha tezroq bo'lishini xohladi, bu esa, u ishonganidek, yoqimli Sharlottasi uchun uni eng baxtli erkakka aylantiradigan erta kunni belgilashga raddiyasiz dalil bo'ladi.

paras.en: Mr. Collins's return into Hertfordshire was no longer a matter of pleasure to Mrs. Bennet. On the contrary, she was as much disposed to complain of it as her husband. It was very strange that he should come to Longbourn instead of to Lucas Lodge; it was also very inconvenient and exceedingly troublesome. She hated having visitors in the house while her health was so indifferent, and lovers were of all people the most disagreeable. Such were the gentle murmurs of Mrs. Bennet, and they gave way only to the greater distress of Mr. Bingley's continued absence.
paras.uz: Janob Kollinzning Xertfordshirga qaytishi endi missis Bennet uchun zavq manbai emasdi. Aksincha, u ham eri kabi bundan shikoyat qilishga moyil edi. Uning Lukas Loj o'rniga Longbornga kelishi juda g'alati edi; bu juda noqulay va nihoyatda tashvishli ham edi. Sog'lig'i bunchalik yomon bo'lgan paytda uyda mehmonlar bo'lishini u yomon ko'rardi, oshiqlar esa hammadan ham yoqimsiz odamlar edi. Missis Bennetning yumshoq g'udranishlari shunday edi va ular faqat janob Binglining davom etayotgan yo'qligidan kelgan kattaroq tashvish oldida chekinardi.

paras.en: Neither Jane nor Elizabeth were comfortable on this subject. Day after day passed away without bringing any other tidings of him than the report which shortly prevailed in Meryton of his coming no more to Netherfield the whole winter; a report which highly incensed Mrs. Bennet, and which she never failed to contradict as a most scandalous falsehood.
paras.uz: Na Jeyn, na Elizabet bu mavzuda xotirjam emasdi. Kunlar ketidan kunlar o'tdi va u haqida tez orada Meritonda tarqalgan, u butun qish Nezerfildga boshqa kelmaydi degan mish-mishdan boshqa hech qanday xabar keltirmadi; bu mish-mish missis Bennetni qattiq g'azablantirdi va u uni eng sharmandali yolg'on deb rad etishni hech qachon kanda qilmadi.

paras.en: Even Elizabeth began to fear--not that Bingley was indifferent--but that his sisters would be successful in keeping him away. Unwilling as she was to admit an idea so destructive of Jane's happiness, and so dishonorable to the stability of her lover, she could not prevent its frequently occurring. The united efforts of his two unfeeling sisters and of his overpowering friend, assisted by the attractions of Miss Darcy and the amusements of London might be too much, she feared, for the strength of his attachment.
paras.uz: Hatto Elizabet ham qo'rqa boshladi — Bingli befarq ekanidan emas — uning opa-singillari uni uzoqda ushlab turishga muvaffaq bo'lishidan. Jeynning baxtini shunchalik yemiruvchi va uning sevgilisining barqarorligiga shunchalik nomunosib fikrni tan olishni qanchalik istamasa ham, uning tez-tez xayoliga kelishiga to'sqinlik qila olmadi. U qo'rqardiki, ikki bag'ritosh opa-singili va uni bosib oluvchi do'stining birgalikdagi sa'y-harakatlari, miss Darsining jozibasi va London ko'ngilxushliklari yordamida, uning mehrining kuchi uchun haddan tashqari ko'p bo'lishi mumkin.

paras.en: As for Jane, her anxiety under this suspense was, of course, more painful than Elizabeth's, but whatever she felt she was desirous of concealing, and between herself and Elizabeth, therefore, the subject was never alluded to. But as no such delicacy restrained her mother, an hour seldom passed in which she did not talk of Bingley, express her impatience for his arrival, or even require Jane to confess that if he did not come back she would think herself very ill used. It needed all Jane's steady mildness to bear these attacks with tolerable tranquillity.
paras.uz: Jeynga kelsak, bu noaniqlikdagi tashvishi, albatta, Elizabetnikidan og'riqliroq edi, lekin nimani his qilmasin, uni yashirishni istardi, shuning uchun o'zi va Elizabet o'rtasida bu mavzuga hech qachon ishora qilinmasdi. Lekin onasini bunday noziklik to'xtatmagani uchun, u Bingli haqida gapirmagan, uning kelishiga sabrsizligini bildirmagan yoki hatto Jeyndan agar u qaytmasa, o'zini juda yomon munosabatda bo'lingan deb hisoblashini tan olishni talab qilmagan soat kamdan-kam o'tardi. Bu hujumlarga ancha xotirjamlik bilan bardosh berish uchun Jeynning butun barqaror muloyimligi kerak edi.

paras.en: Mr. Collins returned most punctually on Monday fortnight, but his reception at Longbourn was not quite so gracious as it had been on his first introduction. He was too happy, however, to need much attention; and luckily for the others, the business of love-making relieved them from a great deal of his company. The chief of every day was spent by him at Lucas Lodge, and he sometimes returned to Longbourn only in time to make an apology for his absence before the family went to bed.
paras.uz: Janob Kollinz ikki haftadan keyingi dushanba kuni juda aniq qaytdi, lekin uni Longbornda birinchi tanishuvdagidek unchalik iltifot bilan kutib olishmadi. Biroq u ko'p e'tiborga muhtoj bo'lmaslik darajada baxtli edi; va boshqalarning baxtiga, sevgi ishlari ularni uning davrasidan ancha qutqardi. U har kunning asosiy qismini Lukas Lojda o'tkazardi va ba'zan Longbornga faqat oila uxlashga ketishidan oldin yo'qligi uchun uzr so'rashga ulguradigan vaqtda qaytardi.

paras.en: Mrs. Bennet was really in a most pitiable state. The very mention of anything concerning the match threw her into an agony of ill-humour, and wherever she went she was sure of hearing it talked of. The sight of Miss Lucas was odious to her. As her successor in that house, she regarded her with jealous abhorrence. Whenever Charlotte came to see them, she concluded her to be anticipating the hour of possession; and whenever she spoke in a low voice to Mr. Collins, was convinced that they were talking of the Longbourn estate, and resolving to turn herself and her daughters out of the house, as soon as Mr. Bennet were dead. She complained bitterly of all this to her husband.
paras.uz: Missis Bennet haqiqatan ham eng achinarli ahvolda edi. Nikohga oid har qanday narsaning tilga olinishi ham uni g'azab azobiga solardi va qayerga bormasin, bu haqda gaplashayotganini eshitishiga amin edi. Miss Lukasni ko'rish unga jirkanch edi. Bu uydagi vorisi sifatida u unga hasadli nafrat bilan qarardi. Sharlotta ularni ko'rgani kelganda, u uni mulkka egalik qilish soatini kutyapti deb xulosa qilardi; har safar u janob Kollinz bilan past ovozda gaplashganda, ular Longborn mulki haqida gaplashayotganiga va janob Bennet o'lishi bilanoq uni va qizlarini uydan haydab chiqarishga qaror qilayotganiga amin bo'lardi. U bularning hammasidan eriga achchiq shikoyat qildi.

paras.en: “Indeed, Mr. Bennet,” said she, “it is very hard to think that Charlotte Lucas should ever be mistress of this house, that I should be forced to make way for her, and live to see her take her place in it!”
paras.uz: «Rostdan ham, janob Bennet, — dedi u, — Sharlotta Lukas qachondir bu uyning bekasi bo'lishini, men unga yo'l berishga majbur bo'lishimni va uning bu yerda mening o'rnimni egallashini ko'rish uchun yashashimni o'ylash juda og'ir!»

paras.en: “My dear, do not give way to such gloomy thoughts. Let us hope for better things. Let us flatter ourselves that I may be the survivor.”
paras.uz: «Azizim, bunday qayg'uli fikrlarga berilmang. Yaxshiroq narsalarga umid qilaylik. O'zimizni men tirik qoladigan bo'lishim mumkin degan fikr bilan ovutaylik».

paras.en: This was not very consoling to Mrs. Bennet, and therefore, instead of making any answer, she went on as before.
paras.uz: Bu missis Bennet uchun unchalik taskinli emasdi, shuning uchun u hech qanday javob berish o'rniga avvalgidek davom etdi.

paras.en: “I cannot bear to think that they should have all this estate. If it was not for the entail, I should not mind it.”
paras.uz: «Ular bu butun mulkka ega bo'lishini o'ylashga chiday olmayman. Agar meros cheklovi bo'lmaganida, bunga qarshi bo'lmasdim».

paras.en: “What should not you mind?”
paras.uz: «Nimaga qarshi bo'lmasdingiz?»

paras.en: “I should not mind anything at all.”
paras.uz: «Umuman hech narsaga qarshi bo'lmasdim».

paras.en: “Let us be thankful that you are preserved from a state of such insensibility.”
paras.uz: «Bunday befarqlik holatidan saqlanganingiz uchun shukr qilaylik».

paras.en: “I never can be thankful, Mr. Bennet, for anything about the entail. How anyone could have the conscience to entail away an estate from one's own daughters, I cannot understand; and all for the sake of Mr. Collins too! Why should he have it more than anybody else?”
paras.uz: «Meros cheklovi haqidagi hech narsa uchun hech qachon shukr qila olmayman, janob Bennet. Qanday qilib kimningdir o'z qizlaridan mulkni meros cheklovi bilan tortib olishga vijdoni yetishini tushuna olmayman; buning ustiga hammasi janob Kollinz uchun! Nega u boshqa har kimdan ko'ra unga ega bo'lishi kerak?»

paras.en: “I leave it to yourself to determine,” said Mr. Bennet.
paras.uz: «Buni o'zingiz hal qilishingizga qoldiraman», — dedi janob Bennet.

quiz.why_uz: U Longbourn endi Lukaslar qo'liga o'tishidan qo'rqadi.

chapters.title: Jane's Sorrow
chapters.recap_uz: Miss Binglining xati umidni so'ndiradi. Jeyn hech kimni ayblamaydi. Uikhem Longbournga tez-tez keladi va hamma Darsini yomonlaydi.

paras.en: Miss Bingley's letter arrived, and put an end to doubt. The very first sentence conveyed the assurance of their being all settled in London for the winter, and concluded with her brother's regret at not having had time to pay his respects to his friends in Hertfordshire before he left the country.
paras.uz: Miss Binglining xati keldi va shubhaga barham berdi. Birinchi jumlaning o'zi ularning hammasi qishni o'tkazish uchun Londonda joylashib olganiga ishontirardi va akasining bu yerlardan ketishidan oldin Xertfordshirdagi do'stlariga hurmatini bildirishga vaqt topa olmaganidan afsusi bilan tugardi.

paras.en: Hope was over, entirely over; and when Jane could attend to the rest of the letter, she found little, except the professed affection of the writer, that could give her any comfort. Miss Darcy's praise occupied the chief of it. Her many attractions were again dwelt on, and Caroline boasted joyfully of their increasing intimacy, and ventured to predict the accomplishment of the wishes which had been unfolded in her former letter. She wrote also with great pleasure of her brother's being an inmate of Mr. Darcy's house, and mentioned with raptures some plans of the latter with regard to new furniture.
paras.uz: Umid tugadi, butunlay tugadi; Jeyn xatning qolgan qismiga e'tibor bera olganida, muallifning izhor qilgan mehridan boshqa unga taskin bera oladigan narsani kam topdi. Uning asosiy qismini miss Darsini maqtash egallagan edi. Uning ko'p jozibalari yana tilga olingan, Kerolayn ularning ortib borayotgan yaqinligi bilan quvonch bilan maqtangan va avvalgi xatida ochib bergan istaklari amalga oshishini bashorat qilishga jur'at etgan edi. U shuningdek akasining janob Darsining uyida yashayotgani haqida katta zavq bilan yozgan va janob Darsining yangi mebel bo'yicha ba'zi rejalarini hayajon bilan tilga olgan edi.

paras.en: Elizabeth, to whom Jane very soon communicated the chief of all this, heard it in silent indignation. Her heart was divided between concern for her sister, and resentment against all others. To Caroline's assertion of her brother's being partial to Miss Darcy she paid no credit. That he was really fond of Jane, she doubted no more than she had ever done; and much as she had always been disposed to like him, she could not think without anger, hardly without contempt, on that easiness of temper, that want of proper resolution, which now made him the slave of his designing friends, and led him to sacrifice of his own happiness to the caprice of their inclination.
paras.uz: Jeyn bularning asosiy qismini tez orada aytib bergan Elizabet buni jim g'azab bilan tingladi. Uning qalbi opasi uchun tashvish va qolgan hammaga nisbatan g'azab o'rtasida bo'lingan edi. Kerolaynning akasi miss Darsiga moyil ekani haqidagi da'vosiga u hech qanday ishonmadi. U Jeynni chindan ham yaxshi ko'rishiga u hech qachon shubha qilmaganidek, hozir ham shubha qilmadi; va uni doim yoqtirishga qanchalik moyil bo'lmasin, uni endi ayyor do'stlarining quliga aylantirgan va o'z baxtini ularning injiq xohishlariga qurbon qilishga olib kelgan o'sha yumshoq fe'lni, o'sha munosib qat'iyatning yetishmasligini g'azabsiz, deyarli nafratsiz o'ylay olmadi.

paras.en: Had his own happiness, however, been the only sacrifice, he might have been allowed to sport with it in whatever manner he thought best, but her sister's was involved in it, as she thought he must be sensible himself. It was a subject, in short, on which reflection would be long indulged, and must be unavailing. She could think of nothing else; and yet whether Bingley's regard had really died away, or were suppressed by his friends' interference; whether he had been aware of Jane's attachment, or whether it had escaped his observation; whatever were the case, though her opinion of him must be materially affected by the difference, her sister's situation remained the same, her peace equally wounded.
paras.uz: Biroq agar faqat o'z baxti qurbon qilinganida, unga u bilan o'zi eng yaxshi deb bilgan har qanday tarzda o'ynashga ruxsat berilishi mumkin edi, lekin unda opasining baxti ham bor edi, Elizabet o'ylaganidek, buni u o'zi ham sezishi kerak edi. Qisqasi, bu uzoq o'ylanadigan va befoyda bo'lishi kerak bo'lgan mavzu edi. U boshqa hech narsani o'ylay olmasdi; shunga qaramay, Binglining mehri chindan ham so'nganmi yoki do'stlarining aralashuvi bilan bostirilganmi; u Jeynning mehridan xabardor bo'lganmi yoki bu uning nazaridan chetda qolganmi — holat qanday bo'lmasin, garchi bu farq uning u haqidagi fikriga jiddiy ta'sir qilishi kerak bo'lsa ham, opasining ahvoli o'zgarmasdi, uning osoyishtaligi xuddi shunday yaralangan edi.

paras.en: A day or two passed before Jane had courage to speak of her feelings to Elizabeth; but at last, on Mrs. Bennet's leaving them together, after a longer irritation than usual about Netherfield and its master, she could not help saying:
paras.uz: Jeyn tuyg'ulari haqida Elizabetga gapirishga jur'at topgunicha bir-ikki kun o'tdi; lekin nihoyat, missis Bennet Nezerfild va uning egasi haqida odatdagidan uzoqroq g'ashlangach, ularni yolg'iz qoldirganida, u aytmay qololmadi:

paras.en: “Oh, that my dear mother had more command over herself! She can have no idea of the pain she gives me by her continual reflections on him. But I will not repine. It cannot last long. He will be forgot, and we shall all be as we were before.”
paras.uz: «Oh, aziz onam o'zini ko'proq tuta olsaydi! U haqida to'xtovsiz gapirishlari menga qanchalik og'riq berishini u tasavvur ham qila olmaydi. Lekin nolimayman. Bu uzoq davom eta olmaydi. U unutiladi va hammamiz avvalgidek bo'lamiz».

paras.en: Elizabeth looked at her sister with incredulous solicitude, but said nothing.
paras.uz: Elizabet opasiga ishonmagan holda tashvish bilan qaradi, lekin hech narsa demadi.

paras.en: “You doubt me,” cried Jane, slightly colouring; “indeed, you have no reason. He may live in my memory as the most amiable man of my acquaintance, but that is all. I have nothing either to hope or fear, and nothing to reproach him with. Thank God! I have not that pain. A little time, therefore--I shall certainly try to get the better.”
paras.uz: «Menga shubha qilyapsan, — xitob qildi Jeyn biroz qizarib, — rostdan ham, buning uchun sababing yo'q. U xotiramda tanishlarim ichidagi eng yoqimli erkak sifatida qolishi mumkin, lekin shu bilan tamom. Menda na umid qiladigan, na qo'rqadigan narsa, na uni ayblaydigan narsa bor. Xudoga shukr! Menda bunday og'riq yo'q. Shuning uchun ozgina vaqt — albatta, buni yengishga harakat qilaman».

paras.en: With a stronger voice she soon added, “I have this comfort immediately, that it has not been more than an error of fancy on my side, and that it has done no harm to anyone but myself.”
paras.uz: Tez orada kuchliroq ovoz bilan qo'shib qo'ydi: «Menda hozirning o'zida shunday taskin borki, bu men tomonimdan xayolning xatosidan ortiq narsa bo'lmagan va o'zimdan boshqa hech kimga zarar yetkazmagan».

paras.en: “My dear Jane!” exclaimed Elizabeth, “you are too good. Your sweetness and disinterestedness are really angelic; I do not know what to say to you. I feel as if I had never done you justice, or loved you as you deserve.”
paras.uz: «Azizim Jeyn! — xitob qildi Elizabet. — Sen haddan tashqari yaxshisan. Shirinliging va beg'arazliging chinakam farishtalarcha; senga nima deyishni bilmayman. O'zimni senga hech qachon adolat ko'rsatmagan yoki seni munosib darajada sevmagandek his qilyapman».

paras.en: Miss Bennet eagerly disclaimed all extraordinary merit, and threw back the praise on her sister's warm affection.
paras.uz: Miss Bennet har qanday g'ayrioddiy fazilatni ishtiyoq bilan rad etdi va maqtovni singlisining qizg'in mehriga qaytardi.

paras.en: “Nay,” said Elizabeth, “this is not fair. You wish to think all the world respectable, and are hurt if I speak ill of anybody. I only want to think you perfect, and you set yourself against it. Do not be afraid of my running into any excess, of my encroaching on your privilege of universal good-will. You need not. There are few people whom I really love, and still fewer of whom I think well. The more I see of the world, the more am I dissatisfied with it; and every day confirms my belief of the inconsistency of all human characters, and of the little dependence that can be placed on the appearance of merit or sense. I have met with two instances lately, one I will not mention; the other is Charlotte's marriage. It is unaccountable! In every view it is unaccountable!”
paras.uz: «Yo'q, — dedi Elizabet, — bu adolatdan emas. Sen butun dunyoni hurmatli deb o'ylashni istaysan va men biror kishi haqida yomon gapirsam, ranjiysan. Men faqat seni mukammal deb o'ylashni istayman, sen esa bunga qarshi chiqasan. Biror haddan oshishimdan, hammaga yaxshilik tilash imtiyozingga tajovuz qilishimdan qo'rqma. Bunga hojat yo'q. Men chindan sevadigan odamlar kam, yaxshi o'ylaydiganlarim esa undan ham kam. Dunyoni qanchalik ko'p ko'rsam, undan shunchalik norozi bo'laman; har kun barcha inson xarakterlarining nomuvofiqligiga va fazilat yoki aql ko'rinishiga qanchalik kam ishonish mumkinligiga bo'lgan ishonchimni mustahkamlaydi. Yaqinda ikki misolga duch keldim, birini tilga olmayman; ikkinchisi Sharlottaning nikohi. Bu tushunib bo'lmas! Har jihatdan tushunib bo'lmas!»

paras.en: “My dear Lizzy, do not give way to such feelings as these. They will ruin your happiness. You do not make allowance enough for difference of situation and temper. Consider Mr. Collins's respectability, and Charlotte's steady, prudent character. Remember that she is one of a large family; that as to fortune, it is a most eligible match; and be ready to believe, for everybody's sake, that she may feel something like regard and esteem for our cousin.”
paras.uz: «Azizim Lizzi, bunday tuyg'ularga berilma. Ular baxtingni barbod qiladi. Sen vaziyat va fe'l-atvordagi farqni yetarlicha hisobga olmayapsan. Janob Kollinzning hurmatliligini va Sharlottaning barqaror, oqilona xarakterini o'ylab ko'r. Esingda bo'lsin, u katta oiladan; boylik jihatidan bu juda munosib nikoh; hammaning xotiri uchun uning amakivachchamizga nisbatan hurmat va qadrlashga o'xshash biror narsa his qilishi mumkinligiga ishonishga tayyor bo'l».

paras.en: “To oblige you, I would try to believe almost anything, but no one else could be benefited by such a belief as this; for were I persuaded that Charlotte had any regard for him, I should only think worse of her understanding than I now do of her heart. My dear Jane, Mr. Collins is a conceited, pompous, narrow-minded, silly man; you know he is, as well as I do; and you must feel, as well as I do, that the woman who married him cannot have a proper way of thinking. You shall not defend her, though it is Charlotte Lucas. You shall not, for the sake of one individual, change the meaning of principle and integrity, nor endeavour to persuade yourself or me, that selfishness is prudence, and insensibility of danger security for happiness.”
paras.uz: «Seni xursand qilish uchun deyarli har narsaga ishonishga harakat qilardim, lekin bunday ishonchdan hech kim foyda ko'rmaydi; chunki agar Sharlotta unga nisbatan biror hurmat his qilishiga ishonsam, uning aqli haqida hozir uning qalbi haqida o'ylaganimdan ham yomonroq o'ylagan bo'lardim. Azizim Jeyn, janob Kollinz manman, dabdabaparast, tor fikrli, ahmoq odam; buni sen ham men kabi bilasan; va sen ham men kabi his qilishing kerakki, unga turmushga chiqqan ayolning fikrlash tarzi to'g'ri bo'lishi mumkin emas. Uni himoya qilmaysan, garchi u Sharlotta Lukas bo'lsa ham. Bir kishi uchun tamoyil va halollik ma'nosini o'zgartirmaysan, o'zingni yoki meni xudbinlik oqilonalik, xavfni sezmaslik esa baxt kafolati ekaniga ishontirishga urinmaysan».

paras.en: “I must think your language too strong in speaking of both,” replied Jane; “and I hope you will be convinced of it by seeing them happy together. But enough of this. You alluded to something else. You mentioned two instances. I cannot misunderstand you, but I entreat you, dear Lizzy, not to pain me by thinking that person to blame, and saying your opinion of him is sunk. We must not be so ready to fancy ourselves intentionally injured. We must not expect a lively young man to be always so guarded and circumspect. It is very often nothing but our own vanity that deceives us. Women fancy admiration means more than it does.”
paras.uz: «Ikkalasi haqida gapirganda so'zlaring haddan tashqari keskin deb o'ylashim kerak, — javob berdi Jeyn, — va umid qilamanki, ularni birga baxtli ko'rib, bunga ishonch hosil qilasan. Lekin bu haqda yetar. Sen boshqa narsaga ham ishora qilding. Ikki misolni tilga olding. Seni noto'g'ri tushuna olmayman, lekin iltimos qilaman, aziz Lizzi, o'sha odamni aybdor deb o'ylab va u haqidagi fikring pasayganini aytib, menga og'riq berma. Biz o'zimizni ataylab ranjitilgan deb tasavvur qilishga bunchalik tayyor bo'lmasligimiz kerak. Jo'shqin yosh yigitdan doim bunchalik ehtiyotkor va mulohazali bo'lishini kutmasligimiz kerak. Ko'pincha bizni o'z shuhratparastligimizdan boshqa narsa aldamaydi. Ayollar hayratlanishni u aslida anglatganidan ko'proq narsani anglatadi deb tasavvur qilishadi».

paras.en: “And men take care that they should.”
paras.uz: «Erkaklar esa shunday bo'lishiga g'amxo'rlik qilishadi».

paras.en: “If it is designedly done, they cannot be justified; but I have no idea of there being so much design in the world as some persons imagine.”
paras.uz: «Agar bu ataylab qilinsa, ularni oqlab bo'lmaydi; lekin dunyoda ba'zi odamlar tasavvur qilgandek ko'p qasd bor deb o'ylamayman».

paras.en: “I am far from attributing any part of Mr. Bingley's conduct to design,” said Elizabeth; “but without scheming to do wrong, or to make others unhappy, there may be error, and there may be misery. Thoughtlessness, want of attention to other people's feelings, and want of resolution, will do the business.”
paras.uz: «Janob Binglining xatti-harakatining biror qismini qasdga bog'lashdan yiroqman, — dedi Elizabet, — lekin yomonlik qilishni yoki boshqalarni baxtsiz qilishni rejalashtirmasdan ham xato va baxtsizlik bo'lishi mumkin. Beparvolik, boshqalarning tuyg'ulariga e'tiborsizlik va qat'iyatsizlik bu ishni bajaradi».

paras.en: “And do you impute it to either of those?”
paras.uz: «Va sen buni ulardan biriga bog'laysanmi?»

paras.en: “Yes; to the last. But if I go on, I shall displease you by saying what I think of persons you esteem. Stop me whilst you can.”
paras.uz: «Ha; oxirgisiga. Lekin davom etsam, sen hurmat qiladigan odamlar haqida nima o'ylashimni aytib, ko'nglingni qoldiraman. Iloji borida meni to'xtat».

paras.en: “You persist, then, in supposing his sisters influence him?”
paras.uz: «Demak, sen uning opa-singillari unga ta'sir qiladi deb taxmin qilishda davom etyapsanmi?»

paras.en: “Yes, in conjunction with his friend.”
paras.uz: «Ha, do'sti bilan birgalikda».

paras.en: “I cannot believe it. Why should they try to influence him? They can only wish his happiness; and if he is attached to me, no other woman can secure it.”
paras.uz: «Bunga ishona olmayman. Nega ular unga ta'sir qilishga urinishlari kerak? Ular faqat uning baxtini xohlashlari mumkin; agar u menga bog'langan bo'lsa, boshqa hech bir ayol buni ta'minlay olmaydi».

paras.en: “Your first position is false. They may wish many things besides his happiness; they may wish his increase of wealth and consequence; they may wish him to marry a girl who has all the importance of money, great connections, and pride.”
paras.uz: «Birinchi fikring noto'g'ri. Ular uning baxtidan tashqari ko'p narsani xohlashlari mumkin; ular uning boyligi va mavqei oshishini xohlashlari mumkin; ular uning pulning, katta aloqalarning va g'ururning butun ahamiyatiga ega qizga uylanishini xohlashlari mumkin».

paras.en: “Beyond a doubt, they do wish him to choose Miss Darcy,” replied Jane; “but this may be from better feelings than you are supposing. They have known her much longer than they have known me; no wonder if they love her better. But, whatever may be their own wishes, it is very unlikely they should have opposed their brother's. What sister would think herself at liberty to do it, unless there were something very objectionable? If they believed him attached to me, they would not try to part us; if he were so, they could not succeed. By supposing such an affection, you make everybody acting unnaturally and wrong, and me most unhappy. Do not distress me by the idea. I am not ashamed of having been mistaken--or, at least, it is light, it is nothing in comparison of what I should feel in thinking ill of him or his sisters. Let me take it in the best light, in the light in which it may be understood.”
paras.uz: «Shubhasiz, ular uning miss Darsini tanlashini xohlashadi, — javob berdi Jeyn, — lekin bu sen taxmin qilayotganingdan yaxshiroq tuyg'ulardan bo'lishi mumkin. Ular uni meni bilganlaridan ancha uzoqroq vaqtdan beri bilishadi; uni ko'proq yaxshi ko'rishsa, ajablanarli emas. Lekin ularning o'z istaklari qanday bo'lmasin, akalarining istaklariga qarshi chiqishlari juda ehtimoldan yiroq. Qaysi singil, agar juda e'tirozli biror narsa bo'lmasa, buni qilishga o'zini haqli deb hisoblaydi? Agar ular uni menga bog'langan deb ishonishsa, bizni ajratishga urinmasdi; agar u shunday bo'lsa, ular muvaffaqiyatga erisha olmasdi. Bunday mehrni taxmin qilib, sen hammani g'ayritabiiy va noto'g'ri harakat qilayotgan, meni esa eng baxtsiz qilib ko'rsatyapsan. Bu fikr bilan meni qiynama. Adashganimdan uyalmayman — yoki hech bo'lmaganda bu yengil, u yoki uning opa-singillari haqida yomon o'ylaganda his qiladiganimga nisbatan hech narsa. Menga buni eng yaxshi tomondan, uni tushunish mumkin bo'lgan tomondan qabul qilishga ruxsat ber».

paras.en: Elizabeth could not oppose such a wish; and from this time Mr. Bingley's name was scarcely ever mentioned between them.
paras.uz: Elizabet bunday istakka qarshi chiqa olmadi; shu vaqtdan boshlab ular o'rtasida janob Binglining nomi deyarli hech qachon tilga olinmadi.

paras.en: Mrs. Bennet still continued to wonder and repine at his returning no more, and though a day seldom passed in which Elizabeth did not account for it clearly, there was little chance of her ever considering it with less perplexity. Her daughter endeavoured to convince her of what she did not believe herself, that his attentions to Jane had been merely the effect of a common and transient liking, which ceased when he saw her no more; but though the probability of the statement was admitted at the time, she had the same story to repeat every day. Mrs. Bennet's best comfort was that Mr. Bingley must be down again in the summer.
paras.uz: Missis Bennet hali ham uning boshqa qaytmayotganidan hayron bo'lib, nolishda davom etdi va Elizabet buni aniq tushuntirib bermagan kun kamdan-kam o'tsa ham, uning bunga kamroq hayronlik bilan qarash ehtimoli kam edi. Qizi uni o'zi ishonmagan narsaga — uning Jeynga bo'lgan e'tiborlari shunchaki oddiy va o'tkinchi yoqtirishning natijasi bo'lgani va uni boshqa ko'rmagach, to'xtaganiga ishontirishga urindi; lekin o'sha paytda bu gapning ehtimolligi tan olingan bo'lsa ham, u har kuni xuddi shu hikoyani takrorlashga majbur edi. Missis Bennetning eng yaxshi taskini janob Bingli yozda yana kelishi kerakligi edi.

paras.en: Mr. Bennet treated the matter differently. “So, Lizzy,” said he one day, “your sister is crossed in love, I find. I congratulate her. Next to being married, a girl likes to be crossed a little in love now and then. It is something to think of, and it gives her a sort of distinction among her companions. When is your turn to come? You will hardly bear to be long outdone by Jane. Now is your time. Here are officers enough in Meryton to disappoint all the young ladies in the country. Let Wickham be your man. He is a pleasant fellow, and would jilt you creditably.”
paras.uz: Janob Bennet bu masalaga boshqacha qaradi. «Xo'sh, Lizzi, — dedi u bir kuni, — bilishimcha, opangning muhabbati omadsiz bo'libdi. Uni tabriklayman. Turmushga chiqishdan keyin qiz vaqti-vaqti bilan muhabbatda biroz omadsizlikni yaxshi ko'radi. Bu o'ylash uchun biror narsa va bu unga dugonalari orasida o'ziga xos ajralib turish beradi. Sening navbating qachon keladi? Jeyndan uzoq vaqt ortda qolishga zo'rg'a chidaysan. Hozir sening vaqting. Meritonda mamlakatdagi barcha yosh xonimlarning hafsalasini pir qilish uchun yetarlicha ofitserlar bor. Uikhem seniki bo'lsin. U yoqimli yigit va seni obro'li tarzda tashlab ketadi».

paras.en: “Thank you, sir, but a less agreeable man would satisfy me. We must not all expect Jane's good fortune.”
paras.uz: «Rahmat, ser, lekin meni kamroq yoqimli erkak ham qoniqtiradi. Hammamiz Jeynning omadini kutmasligimiz kerak».

paras.en: “True,” said Mr. Bennet, “but it is a comfort to think that whatever of that kind may befall you, you have an affectionate mother who will make the most of it.”
paras.uz: «To'g'ri, — dedi janob Bennet, — lekin shuni o'ylash taskin beradiki, boshingga shunga o'xshash nima tushmasin, sening undan eng ko'p narsa chiqaradigan mehribon onang bor».

paras.en: Mr. Wickham's society was of material service in dispelling the gloom which the late perverse occurrences had thrown on many of the Longbourn family. They saw him often, and to his other recommendations was now added that of general unreserve. The whole of what Elizabeth had already heard, his claims on Mr. Darcy, and all that he had suffered from him, was now openly acknowledged and publicly canvassed; and everybody was pleased to know how much they had always disliked Mr. Darcy before they had known anything of the matter.
paras.uz: Janob Uikhemning davrasi yaqindagi teskari voqealar Longborn oilasining ko'p a'zolariga solgan g'amginlikni tarqatishda katta xizmat qildi. Ular uni tez-tez ko'rishardi va uning boshqa fazilatlariga endi umumiy ochiqlik ham qo'shildi. Elizabet allaqachon eshitgan hamma narsa — uning janob Darsiga da'volari va undan ko'rgan barcha azoblari endi ochiqchasiga tan olinar va ommaviy muhokama qilinardi; hamma bu ish haqida hech narsa bilmasdan oldin ham janob Darsini doim qanchalik yoqtirmaganini bilib xursand edi.

paras.en: Miss Bennet was the only creature who could suppose there might be any extenuating circumstances in the case, unknown to the society of Hertfordshire; her mild and steady candour always pleaded for allowances, and urged the possibility of mistakes--but by everybody else Mr. Darcy was condemned as the worst of men.
paras.uz: Bu holatda Xertfordshir jamiyatiga noma'lum bo'lgan biror yengillashtiruvchi holatlar bo'lishi mumkinligini taxmin qila oladigan yagona mavjudot miss Bennet edi; uning muloyim va barqaror xolisligi doim chegirma qilishni so'rar va xatolar ehtimolini ta'kidlardi — lekin boshqa hamma janob Darsini eng yomon odam deb hukm qilardi.
