chapters.title: The First Proposal
chapters.recap_uz: Darsi kutilmaganda kelib, Elizabetga sevgisini izhor qiladi va turmush taklif qiladi, lekin uning oilasi pastligini ham aytadi. Elizabet g'azab bilan rad etadi va uni Jeyn va Uikhem uchun ayblaydi.

paras.en: When they were gone, Elizabeth, as if intending to exasperate herself as much as possible against Mr. Darcy, chose for her employment the examination of all the letters which Jane had written to her since her being in Kent. They contained no actual complaint, nor was there any revival of past occurrences, or any communication of present suffering. But in all, and in almost every line of each, there was a want of that cheerfulness which had been used to characterise her style, and which, proceeding from the serenity of a mind at ease with itself and kindly disposed towards everyone, had been scarcely ever clouded. Elizabeth noticed every sentence conveying the idea of uneasiness, with an attention which it had hardly received on the first perusal. Mr. Darcy's shameful boast of what misery he had been able to inflict, gave her a keener sense of her sister's sufferings.
paras.uz: Ular ketgach, Elizabet go'yo janob Darsiga qarshi o'zini iloji boricha ko'proq g'azablantirmoqchi bo'lganday, Kentga kelganidan beri Jeyn unga yozgan barcha xatlarni ko'zdan kechirishni mashg'ulot qilib tanladi. Ularda hech qanday ochiq shikoyat yo'q edi, o'tgan voqealar ham qayta tilga olinmagan, hozirgi azob haqida ham hech narsa aytilmagan edi. Lekin hammasida, deyarli har birining har bir satrida uning uslubini ajratib turgan, o'zi bilan murosada bo'lgan va hammaga mehribon bo'lgan qalbning osoyishtaligidan kelib chiqadigan va deyarli hech qachon xiralashmagan o'sha shodlik yetishmasdi. Elizabet bezovtalik fikrini bildiruvchi har bir jumlaga birinchi o'qishda deyarli berilmagan e'tibor bilan qaradi. Janob Darsining qanday azob yetkaza olgani bilan sharmandalarcha maqtanishi unga opasining iztiroblarini yanada o'tkirroq his qildirdi.

paras.en: It was some consolation to think that his visit to Rosings was to end on the day after the next--and, a still greater, that in less than a fortnight she should herself be with Jane again, and enabled to contribute to the recovery of her spirits, by all that affection could do.
paras.uz: Uning Rozingsdagi tashrifi indinga tugashini o'ylash biroz taskin berardi — undan ham kattaroq taskin esa ikki haftadan kamroq vaqt ichida o'zi yana Jeyn bilan birga bo'lishi va mehr qila oladigan hamma narsa bilan uning ruhiyatini tiklashga hissa qo'sha olishi edi.

paras.en: She could not think of Darcy's leaving Kent without remembering that his cousin was to go with him; but Colonel Fitzwilliam had made it clear that he had no intentions at all, and agreeable as he was, she did not mean to be unhappy about him.
paras.uz: U Darsining Kentni tark etishini uning amakivachchasi ham u bilan ketishini eslamasdan o'ylay olmasdi; lekin polkovnik Fitsuilyam hech qanday niyati yo'qligini aniq qilib qo'ygan edi va u qanchalik yoqimli bo'lmasin, Elizabet u tufayli baxtsiz bo'lishni niyat qilmadi.

paras.en: While settling this point, she was suddenly roused by the sound of the door-bell, and her spirits were a little fluttered by the idea of its being Colonel Fitzwilliam himself, who had once before called late in the evening, and might now come to inquire particularly after her. But this idea was soon banished, and her spirits were very differently affected, when, to her utter amazement, she saw Mr. Darcy walk into the room. In an hurried manner he immediately began an inquiry after her health, imputing his visit to a wish of hearing that she were better. She answered him with cold civility. He sat down for a few moments, and then getting up, walked about the room. Elizabeth was surprised, but said not a word. After a silence of several minutes, he came towards her in an agitated manner, and thus began:
paras.uz: Bu masalani hal qilayotganda, uni to'satdan eshik qo'ng'irog'ining ovozi hushyor tortdi va bu bir marta kechqurun kech kelgan polkovnik Fitsuilyamning o'zi bo'lishi mumkin, endi ayniqsa uning ahvolini so'rash uchun kelgandir degan fikrdan kayfiyati biroz to'lqinlandi. Lekin bu fikr tez orada quvildi va uning kayfiyatiga butunlay boshqacha ta'sir qilindi, chunki u mutlaq hayrat ichida janob Darsining xonaga kirib kelayotganini ko'rdi. U shoshqaloq tarzda darhol uning sog'lig'ini so'ray boshladi va tashrifini uning tuzalganini eshitish istagiga bog'ladi. U unga sovuq xushmuomalalik bilan javob berdi. U bir necha lahza o'tirdi, keyin turib, xonada u yoqdan-bu yoqqa yurdi. Elizabet hayron bo'ldi, lekin bir og'iz ham gapirmadi. Bir necha daqiqalik sukutdan keyin u hayajonlangan holda uning oldiga keldi va shunday boshladi:

paras.en: “In vain I have struggled. It will not do. My feelings will not be repressed. You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.”
paras.uz: «Behuda kurashdim. Foydasi yo'q. Tuyg'ularimni bostirib bo'lmaydi. Sizga qanchalik qizg'in maftun ekanimni va sizni sevishimni aytishimga ruxsat berishingiz kerak».

paras.en: Elizabeth's astonishment was beyond expression. She stared, coloured, doubted, and was silent. This he considered sufficient encouragement; and the avowal of all that he felt, and had long felt for her, immediately followed. He spoke well; but there were feelings besides those of the heart to be detailed; and he was not more eloquent on the subject of tenderness than of pride. His sense of her inferiority--of its being a degradation--of the family obstacles which had always opposed to inclination, were dwelt on with a warmth which seemed due to the consequence he was wounding, but was very unlikely to recommend his suit.
paras.uz: Elizabetning hayrati ta'riflab bo'lmas edi. U tikilib qoldi, qizardi, shubhalandi va jim turdi. U buni yetarli rag'bat deb hisobladi; va darhol unga nisbatan his qilgan va uzoq vaqtdan beri his qilib kelayotgan hamma narsani izhor qilish boshlandi. U yaxshi gapirdi; lekin qalb tuyg'ularidan tashqari batafsil aytiladigan boshqa tuyg'ular ham bor edi; va u mehr mavzusida g'urur mavzusidagidan ko'ra notiqroq emasdi. Uning past mavqeini — bu o'zini kamsitish ekanini — moyillikka doim qarshi turgan oilaviy to'siqlarni his qilishi shunday qizg'inlik bilan bayon qilindiki, bu u yaralayotgan mavqega mos ko'rinardi, lekin sovchiligini tavsiya qilishi juda ehtimoldan yiroq edi.

paras.en: In spite of her deeply-rooted dislike, she could not be insensible to the compliment of such a man's affection, and though her intentions did not vary for an instant, she was at first sorry for the pain he was to receive; till, roused to resentment by his subsequent language, she lost all compassion in anger. She tried, however, to compose herself to answer him with patience, when he should have done. He concluded with representing to her the strength of that attachment which, in spite of all his endeavours, he had found impossible to conquer; and with expressing his hope that it would now be rewarded by her acceptance of his hand. As he said this, she could easily see that he had no doubt of a favourable answer. He spoke of apprehension and anxiety, but his countenance expressed real security. Such a circumstance could only exasperate farther, and, when he ceased, the colour rose into her cheeks, and she said:
paras.uz: Chuqur ildiz otgan yoqtirmasligiga qaramay, u bunday erkakning mehri ko'rsatgan iltifotga befarq bo'la olmadi va niyati bir lahzaga ham o'zgarmagan bo'lsa ham, avvaliga u oladigan og'riq uchun achindi; toki uning keyingi so'zlari uni g'azablantirib, barcha hamdardligini jahl ichida yo'qotdi. Biroq u gapini tugatgach, unga sabr bilan javob berish uchun o'zini bosishga urindi. U butun sa'y-harakatlariga qaramay yengib bo'lmas deb topgan mehrining kuchini unga tasvirlab va endi bu uning qo'lini qabul qilishi bilan taqdirlanishiga umidini bildirib, gapini tugatdi. U shunday deyarkan, Elizabet uning ijobiy javobga hech qanday shubhasi yo'qligini osongina ko'rdi. U xavotir va tashvish haqida gapirdi, lekin yuzi haqiqiy ishonchni ifodalardi. Bunday holat uni faqat yanada g'azablantirishi mumkin edi va u to'xtaganda, yonoqlari qizarib, dedi:

paras.en: “In such cases as this, it is, I believe, the established mode to express a sense of obligation for the sentiments avowed, however unequally they may be returned. It is natural that obligation should be felt, and if I could feel gratitude, I would now thank you. But I cannot--I have never desired your good opinion, and you have certainly bestowed it most unwillingly. I am sorry to have occasioned pain to anyone. It has been most unconsciously done, however, and I hope will be of short duration. The feelings which, you tell me, have long prevented the acknowledgment of your regard, can have little difficulty in overcoming it after this explanation.”
paras.uz: «Bunday hollarda, menimcha, izhor qilingan tuyg'ular uchun, ular qanchalik teng javob topmasin, minnatdorlik hissini bildirish o'rnatilgan odat. Minnatdorlik his qilinishi tabiiy va agar minnatdorlik his qila olganimda, hozir sizga rahmat aytgan bo'lardim. Lekin qila olmayman — men hech qachon sizning yaxshi fikringizni istamaganman, siz esa uni, albatta, juda istamay berdingiz. Birovga og'riq yetkazganimdan afsusdaman. Biroq bu mutlaqo bilmagan holda qilingan va umid qilamanki, qisqa davom etadi. Siz aytganingizdek, uzoq vaqt mehringizni tan olishingizga to'sqinlik qilgan tuyg'ular bu tushuntirishdan keyin uni yengishda qiynalmasa kerak».

paras.en: Mr. Darcy, who was leaning against the mantelpiece with his eyes fixed on her face, seemed to catch her words with no less resentment than surprise. His complexion became pale with anger, and the disturbance of his mind was visible in every feature. He was struggling for the appearance of composure, and would not open his lips till he believed himself to have attained it. The pause was to Elizabeth's feelings dreadful. At length, with a voice of forced calmness, he said:
paras.uz: Kamin tokchasiga suyanib, ko'zlarini uning yuziga qadab turgan janob Darsi uning so'zlarini hayratdan kam bo'lmagan g'azab bilan ilg'aganday ko'rindi. Uning yuzi g'azabdan oqardi va qalbining bezovtaligi har bir chizig'ida ko'rinib turardi. U xotirjamlik qiyofasi uchun kurashardi va unga erishdim deb ishonmaguncha lablarini ochmadi. Sukut Elizabetning tuyg'ulari uchun dahshatli edi. Nihoyat, majburiy xotirjam ovoz bilan u dedi:

paras.en: “And this is all the reply which I am to have the honour of expecting! I might, perhaps, wish to be informed why, with so little endeavour at civility, I am thus rejected. But it is of small importance.”
paras.uz: «Va men kutish sharafiga muyassar bo'ladigan javob shu xolosmi! Ehtimol, nega xushmuomalalikka bunchalik kam urinish bilan meni bunday rad etishayotganini bilishni istardim. Lekin bu unchalik muhim emas».

paras.en: “I might as well inquire,” replied she, “why with so evident a desire of offending and insulting me, you chose to tell me that you liked me against your will, against your reason, and even against your character? Was not this some excuse for incivility, if I was uncivil? But I have other provocations. You know I have. Had not my feelings decided against you--had they been indifferent, or had they even been favourable, do you think that any consideration would tempt me to accept the man who has been the means of ruining, perhaps for ever, the happiness of a most beloved sister?”
paras.uz: «Men ham xuddi shunday so'rashim mumkin, — javob berdi u, — nega meni ranjitish va haqorat qilish istagi bilan meni o'z irodangizga, aqlingizga va hatto xarakteringizga qarshi yoqtirishingizni aytishni tanladingiz? Agar men xushmuomalasiz bo'lgan bo'lsam, bu xushmuomalasizlik uchun biroz bahona emasmi? Lekin menda boshqa sabablar ham bor. Bilasiz, bor. Agar tuyg'ularim sizga qarshi hal qilmagan bo'lsa ham — agar ular befarq yoki hatto ijobiy bo'lganida ham — eng sevikli opamning baxtini, ehtimol abadiy, barbod qilishga sababchi bo'lgan erkakni qabul qilishga biror mulohaza meni undashi mumkin deb o'ylaysizmi?»

paras.en: As she pronounced these words, Mr. Darcy changed colour; but the emotion was short, and he listened without attempting to interrupt her while she continued:
paras.uz: U bu so'zlarni aytganda, janob Darsining rangi o'zgardi; lekin hayajon qisqa bo'ldi va u davom etayotganda uning gapini bo'lishga urinmay tingladi:

paras.en: “I have every reason in the world to think ill of you. No motive can excuse the unjust and ungenerous part you acted there. You dare not, you cannot deny, that you have been the principal, if not the only means of dividing them from each other--of exposing one to the censure of the world for caprice and instability, and the other to its derision for disappointed hopes, and involving them both in misery of the acutest kind.”
paras.uz: «Siz haqingizda yomon o'ylashim uchun dunyodagi barcha asoslarim bor. Hech qanday sabab u yerda o'ynagan adolatsiz va pastkash rolingizni oqlay olmaydi. Siz ularni bir-biridan ajratishda yagona bo'lmasa ham, asosiy vosita bo'lganingizni — birini injiqlik va beqarorlik uchun dunyoning qoralashiga, ikkinchisini esa puchga chiqqan umidlar uchun uning masxarasiga duchor qilganingizni va ikkalasini ham eng o'tkir azobga solganingizni inkor etishga jur'at eta olmaysiz, inkor eta olmaysiz».

paras.en: She paused, and saw with no slight indignation that he was listening with an air which proved him wholly unmoved by any feeling of remorse. He even looked at her with a smile of affected incredulity.
paras.uz: U to'xtadi va zarracha bo'lmagan g'azab bilan uning hech qanday pushaymonlik tuyg'usidan butunlay ta'sirlanmaganini isbotlaydigan qiyofada tinglayotganini ko'rdi. U hatto unga soxta ishonmaslik tabassumi bilan qaradi.

paras.en: “Can you deny that you have done it?” she repeated.
paras.uz: «Buni qilganingizni inkor eta olasizmi?» — takrorladi u.

paras.en: With assumed tranquillity he then replied: “I have no wish of denying that I did everything in my power to separate my friend from your sister, or that I rejoice in my success. Towards him I have been kinder than towards myself.”
paras.uz: Shunda u soxta xotirjamlik bilan javob berdi: «Do'stimni opangizdan ajratish uchun qo'limdan kelgan hamma narsani qilganimni yoki muvaffaqiyatimdan xursand ekanimni inkor etish niyatim yo'q. Unga o'zimdan ko'ra mehribonroq bo'ldim».

paras.en: Elizabeth disdained the appearance of noticing this civil reflection, but its meaning did not escape, nor was it likely to conciliate her.
paras.uz: Elizabet bu xushmuomala mulohazani sezganday ko'rinishni o'ziga ep ko'rmadi, lekin uning ma'nosi undan chetda qolmadi va uni murosaga keltirishi ham ehtimoldan yiroq edi.

paras.en: “But it is not merely this affair,” she continued, “on which my dislike is founded. Long before it had taken place my opinion of you was decided. Your character was unfolded in the recital which I received many months ago from Mr. Wickham. On this subject, what can you have to say? In what imaginary act of friendship can you here defend yourself? or under what misrepresentation can you here impose upon others?”
paras.uz: «Lekin mening yoqtirmasligim faqat bu ishga asoslanmagan, — davom etdi u. — U sodir bo'lishidan ancha oldin siz haqingizdagi fikrim qat'iylashgan edi. Xarakteringiz ko'p oylar oldin janob Uikhemdan eshitgan hikoyamda ochilib qolgan edi. Bu mavzuda nima deya olasiz? Qaysi xayoliy do'stlik harakati bilan bu yerda o'zingizni himoya qila olasiz? Yoki qanday noto'g'ri talqin bilan bu yerda boshqalarni aldaysiz?»

paras.en: “You take an eager interest in that gentleman's concerns,” said Darcy, in a less tranquil tone, and with a heightened colour.
paras.uz: «Siz o'sha janobning ishlariga katta qiziqish bildiryapsiz», — dedi Darsi kamroq xotirjam ohangda va yuzi yanada qizarib.

paras.en: “Who that knows what his misfortunes have been, can help feeling an interest in him?”
paras.uz: «Uning qanday baxtsizliklarga uchraganini bilgan kim unga qiziqish bildirmay qola oladi?»

paras.en: “His misfortunes!” repeated Darcy contemptuously; “yes, his misfortunes have been great indeed.”
paras.uz: «Uning baxtsizliklari! — nafrat bilan takrorladi Darsi. — Ha, uning baxtsizliklari haqiqatan ham katta bo'lgan».

paras.en: “And of your infliction,” cried Elizabeth with energy. “You have reduced him to his present state of poverty--comparative poverty. You have withheld the advantages which you must know to have been designed for him. You have deprived the best years of his life of that independence which was no less his due than his desert. You have done all this! and yet you can treat the mention of his misfortune with contempt and ridicule.”
paras.uz: «Va ularni siz yetkazgansiz, — g'ayrat bilan xitob qildi Elizabet. — Siz uni hozirgi qashshoqlik holatiga — nisbiy qashshoqlikka tushirdingiz. Siz uning uchun mo'ljallanganini bilishingiz kerak bo'lgan imtiyozlarni undan ushlab qoldingiz. Siz uning hayotining eng yaxshi yillarini unga tegishli bo'lgani kabi, u loyiq bo'lgan mustaqillikdan mahrum qildingiz. Bularning hammasini siz qildingiz! Shunga qaramay, uning baxtsizligi tilga olinganda nafrat va masxara bilan munosabatda bo'la olasiz».

paras.en: “And this,” cried Darcy, as he walked with quick steps across the room, “is your opinion of me! This is the estimation in which you hold me! I thank you for explaining it so fully. My faults, according to this calculation, are heavy indeed! But perhaps,” added he, stopping in his walk, and turning towards her, “these offenses might have been overlooked, had not your pride been hurt by my honest confession of the scruples that had long prevented my forming any serious design. These bitter accusations might have been suppressed, had I, with greater policy, concealed my struggles, and flattered you into the belief of my being impelled by unqualified, unalloyed inclination; by reason, by reflection, by everything. But disguise of every sort is my abhorrence. Nor am I ashamed of the feelings I related. They were natural and just. Could you expect me to rejoice in the inferiority of your connections?--to congratulate myself on the hope of relations, whose condition in life is so decidedly beneath my own?”
paras.uz: «Demak, bu, — xitob qildi Darsi, xona bo'ylab tez qadamlar bilan yurarkan, — sizning men haqimdagi fikringiz! Meni shunday baholar ekansiz! Buni bunchalik to'liq tushuntirganingiz uchun rahmat. Bu hisob-kitobga ko'ra, mening ayblarim haqiqatan ham og'ir! Lekin, ehtimol, — qo'shib qo'ydi u yurishdan to'xtab, unga o'girilib, — agar uzoq vaqt menga jiddiy niyat qilishga to'sqinlik qilgan ikkilanishlarimni halol tan olishim g'ururingizni ranjitmaganida, bu gunohlarga e'tibor berilmagan bo'lardi. Agar men kattaroq siyosat bilan kurashlarimni yashirib, sizni meni so'zsiz, beg'ubor moyillik — aql, mulohaza, hamma narsa harakatga keltirgan, degan ishonchga xushomad bilan undaganimda, bu achchiq ayblovlar bostirilgan bo'lardi. Lekin har qanday niqoblanishdan nafratlanaman. Aytgan tuyg'ularimdan ham uyalmayman. Ular tabiiy va adolatli edi. Qarindoshlaringizning pastligidan xursand bo'lishimni kuta olarmidingiz? — hayotdagi ahvoli menikidan shunchalik aniq past bo'lgan qarindoshlar umidi bilan o'zimni tabriklashimni?»

paras.en: Elizabeth felt herself growing more angry every moment; yet she tried to the utmost to speak with composure when she said:
paras.uz: Elizabet har lahza g'azabi ortib borayotganini his qildi; shunga qaramay, gapirganda iloji boricha xotirjam gapirishga harakat qildi:

paras.en: “You are mistaken, Mr. Darcy, if you suppose that the mode of your declaration affected me in any other way, than as it spared me the concern which I might have felt in refusing you, had you behaved in a more gentlemanlike manner.”
paras.uz: «Adashyapsiz, janob Darsi, agar izhoringizning tarzi menga boshqacha ta'sir qildi deb o'ylasangiz; u faqat sizni rad etishda his qilishim mumkin bo'lgan afsusdan meni qutqardi, agar siz janoblarga xosroq tarzda o'zingizni tutganingizda».

paras.en: She saw him start at this, but he said nothing, and she continued:
paras.uz: U bundan seskanganini ko'rdi, lekin u hech narsa demadi va u davom etdi:

paras.en: “You could not have made the offer of your hand in any possible way that would have tempted me to accept it.”
paras.uz: «Siz qo'lingizni meni uni qabul qilishga undaydigan hech qanday tarzda taklif qila olmasdingiz».

paras.en: Again his astonishment was obvious; and he looked at her with an expression of mingled incredulity and mortification. She went on:
paras.uz: Yana uning hayrati aniq ko'rindi; u unga ishonmaslik va xo'rlanish aralash ifoda bilan qaradi. U davom etdi:

paras.en: “From the very beginning--from the first moment, I may almost say--of my acquaintance with you, your manners, impressing me with the fullest belief of your arrogance, your conceit, and your selfish disdain of the feelings of others, were such as to form the groundwork of disapprobation on which succeeding events have built so immovable a dislike; and I had not known you a month before I felt that you were the last man in the world whom I could ever be prevailed on to marry.”
paras.uz: «Siz bilan tanishuvimning aynan boshidanoq — deyarli birinchi lahzasidanoq desam bo'ladi — muomalangiz menda kibringizga, manmanligingizga va boshqalarning tuyg'ularini xudbinlarcha mensimasligingizga eng to'liq ishonch uyg'otib, keyingi voqealar shunchalik qat'iy yoqtirmaslikni qurgan norozilik poydevorini tashkil etdi; va sizni bir oy ham bilmasdanoq, siz meni turmushga chiqishga ko'ndirish mumkin bo'lgan dunyodagi eng oxirgi erkak ekaningizni his qildim».

paras.en: “You have said quite enough, madam. I perfectly comprehend your feelings, and have now only to be ashamed of what my own have been. Forgive me for having taken up so much of your time, and accept my best wishes for your health and happiness.”
paras.uz: «Yetarlicha aytdingiz, xonim. Tuyg'ularingizni to'liq tushunaman va endi faqat o'z tuyg'ularim qanday bo'lganidan uyalishim qoldi. Vaqtingizni bunchalik ko'p olganim uchun meni kechiring va sog'ligingiz hamda baxtingiz uchun eng yaxshi tilaklarimni qabul qiling».

paras.en: And with these words he hastily left the room, and Elizabeth heard him the next moment open the front door and quit the house.
paras.uz: Va bu so'zlar bilan u shoshilib xonadan chiqdi, Elizabet keyingi lahzada uning old eshikni ochib, uydan chiqib ketganini eshitdi.

paras.en: The tumult of her mind, was now painfully great. She knew not how to support herself, and from actual weakness sat down and cried for half-an-hour. Her astonishment, as she reflected on what had passed, was increased by every review of it. That she should receive an offer of marriage from Mr. Darcy! That he should have been in love with her for so many months! So much in love as to wish to marry her in spite of all the objections which had made him prevent his friend's marrying her sister, and which must appear at least with equal force in his own case--was almost incredible! It was gratifying to have inspired unconsciously so strong an affection.
paras.uz: Uning qalbidagi to'polon endi og'riqli darajada katta edi. U o'zini qanday tutishni bilmasdi va chinakam holsizlikdan o'tirib, yarim soat yig'ladi. Bo'lib o'tgan voqea haqida o'ylarkan, hayrati har safar qayta ko'rib chiqqanda ortib borardi. Janob Darsidan nikoh taklifi olishi! Uning shuncha oydan beri unga oshiq bo'lgani! Do'stini uning opasiga uylanishdan to'xtatgan va o'z holatida ham hech bo'lmaganda xuddi shunday kuch bilan ko'rinishi kerak bo'lgan barcha e'tirozlarga qaramay unga uylanishni istaydigan darajada oshiq bo'lgani — deyarli aqlga sig'mas edi! Bilmagan holda bunchalik kuchli mehr uyg'otganidan mamnun bo'lish mumkin edi.

paras.en: But his pride, his abominable pride--his shameless avowal of what he had done with respect to Jane--his unpardonable assurance in acknowledging, though he could not justify it, and the unfeeling manner in which he had mentioned Mr. Wickham, his cruelty towards whom he had not attempted to deny, soon overcame the pity which the consideration of his attachment had for a moment excited. She continued in very agitated reflections till the sound of Lady Catherine's carriage made her feel how unequal she was to encounter Charlotte's observation, and hurried her away to her room.
paras.uz: Lekin uning g'ururi, jirkanch g'ururi — Jeynga nisbatan qilgan ishini uyalmasdan tan olishi — oqlay olmasa ham buni tan olishdagi kechirib bo'lmas surbetligi va janob Uikhemni tilga olgan bag'ritosh tarzi, unga nisbatan shafqatsizligini inkor etishga ham urinmagani tez orada uning mehrini o'ylash bir lahzaga uyg'otgan achinishni yengib ketdi. U juda hayajonli o'ylarda davom etdi, toki ledi Ketrin karetasining ovozi unga Sharlottaning kuzatuviga dosh berishga qodir emasligini his qildirib, uni shoshilib xonasiga ketishga majbur qildi.

gloss.ex: You must allow me to tell you how ardently I admire and love you.”
His sense of her inferiority--of its being a degradation--of the family obstacles which had always opposed to inclination, were dwelt on with a warmth which seemed due to the consequence…

Again his astonishment was obvious; and he looked at her with an expression of mingled incredulity and mortification.

Elizabeth's astonishment was beyond expression.
He spoke of apprehension and anxiety, but his countenance expressed real security.

quiz.q: Why does Elizabeth refuse Darcy?
o: He separated Jane and Bingley and, she believes, ruined Wickham; he also insulted her family
quiz.why_uz: Uning so'zlari: «Siz eng oxirgi odam bo'lsangiz ham, men sizga tegmasdim».

quiz.q: What does Darcy mention while proposing?
quiz.why_uz: Uning g'ururi taklifni ham haqoratga aylantiradi.

chapters.title: Darcy's Letter
chapters.recap_uz: Ertasi kuni Darsi Elizabetga xat beradi. U Jeynni sevmaydi deb o'ylaganini va Uikhem aslida pul olib, keyin Darsining 15 yoshli singlisi Jorjianani olib qochmoqchi bo'lganini yozadi.

paras.en: Elizabeth awoke the next morning to the same thoughts and meditations which had at length closed her eyes. She could not yet recover from the surprise of what had happened; it was impossible to think of anything else; and, totally indisposed for employment, she resolved, soon after breakfast, to indulge herself in air and exercise. She was proceeding directly to her favourite walk, when the recollection of Mr. Darcy's sometimes coming there stopped her, and instead of entering the park, she turned up the lane, which led farther from the turnpike-road. The park paling was still the boundary on one side, and she soon passed one of the gates into the ground.
paras.uz: Ertasi kuni ertalab Elizabet nihoyat ko'zlarini yumdirgan o'sha fikr va mulohazalar bilan uyg'ondi. U bo'lib o'tgan voqeadan hali o'ziga kela olmasdi; boshqa hech narsa haqida o'ylash imkonsiz edi va hech qanday mashg'ulotga hushi yo'q holda, nonushtadan ko'p o'tmay toza havo va harakatga berilishga qaror qildi. U to'g'ri sevimli sayr joyiga ketayotgan edi, janob Darsining ba'zan u yerga kelishini eslab to'xtadi va parkka kirish o'rniga pullik yo'ldan uzoqroqqa olib boradigan tor yo'lga burildi. Park panjarasi hali ham bir tomonda chegara edi va u tez orada hududga kiradigan darvozalardan birining yonidan o'tdi.

paras.en: After walking two or three times along that part of the lane, she was tempted, by the pleasantness of the morning, to stop at the gates and look into the park. The five weeks which she had now passed in Kent had made a great difference in the country, and every day was adding to the verdure of the early trees. She was on the point of continuing her walk, when she caught a glimpse of a gentleman within the sort of grove which edged the park; he was moving that way; and, fearful of its being Mr. Darcy, she was directly retreating. But the person who advanced was now near enough to see her, and stepping forward with eagerness, pronounced her name. She had turned away; but on hearing herself called, though in a voice which proved it to be Mr. Darcy, she moved again towards the gate.
paras.uz: Tor yo'lning o'sha qismi bo'ylab ikki-uch marta yurgach, ertalabning yoqimliligi uni darvozalar oldida to'xtab, parkka qarashga undadi. U Kentda o'tkazgan besh hafta atrofda katta o'zgarish yasagan edi va har kuni erta daraxtlarning yashilligini oshirib borardi. U sayrini davom ettirmoqchi bo'lib turganda, parkni o'rab turgan daraxtzor ichida bir janobni ko'rib qoldi; u shu tomonga kelayotgan edi; va bu janob Darsi bo'lishidan qo'rqib, u darhol orqaga chekina boshladi. Lekin yaqinlashayotgan odam endi uni ko'radigan darajada yaqin edi va ishtiyoq bilan oldinga qadam tashlab, uning ismini aytdi. U o'girilib ketgan edi; lekin chaqirilganini eshitib, garchi ovoz janob Darsiniki ekanini isbotlasa ham, yana darvoza tomon yurdi.

paras.en: He had by that time reached it also, and, holding out a letter, which she instinctively took, said, with a look of haughty composure, “I have been walking in the grove some time in the hope of meeting you. Will you do me the honour of reading that letter?” And then, with a slight bow, turned again into the plantation, and was soon out of sight.
paras.uz: U ham shu paytgacha darvozaga yetib kelgan edi va xatni uzatib — u beixtiyor uni oldi — mag'rur xotirjamlik qiyofasida dedi: «Sizni uchratish umidida bir muddat daraxtzorda yurdim. Bu xatni o'qish sharafini menga ko'rsatasizmi?» Keyin yengil ta'zim qilib, yana daraxtzorga burildi va tez orada ko'zdan g'oyib bo'ldi.

paras.en: With no expectation of pleasure, but with the strongest curiosity, Elizabeth opened the letter, and, to her still increasing wonder, perceived an envelope containing two sheets of letter-paper, written quite through, in a very close hand. The envelope itself was likewise full. Pursuing her way along the lane, she then began it. It was dated from Rosings, at eight o'clock in the morning, and was as follows:--
paras.uz: Hech qanday zavq kutmagan, lekin eng kuchli qiziqish bilan Elizabet xatni ochdi va tobora ortib borayotgan hayrat bilan juda zich husnixat bilan to'liq yozilgan ikki varaq qog'ozli konvertni ko'rdi. Konvertning o'zi ham to'la yozilgan edi. Tor yo'l bo'ylab yo'lini davom ettirib, u uni o'qishni boshladi. U Rozingsda, ertalab soat sakkizda yozilgan bo'lib, quyidagicha edi:

paras.en: “Be not alarmed, madam, on receiving this letter, by the apprehension of its containing any repetition of those sentiments or renewal of those offers which were last night so disgusting to you. I write without any intention of paining you, or humbling myself, by dwelling on wishes which, for the happiness of both, cannot be too soon forgotten; and the effort which the formation and the perusal of this letter must occasion, should have been spared, had not my character required it to be written and read. You must, therefore, pardon the freedom with which I demand your attention; your feelings, I know, will bestow it unwillingly, but I demand it of your justice.
paras.uz: «Bu xatni olib, xonim, unda kecha sizga shunchalik jirkanch tuyulgan o'sha tuyg'ularning takrorlanishi yoki o'sha takliflarning yangilanishi bor degan qo'rquvdan xavotirga tushmang. Men ikkalamizning baxtimiz uchun iloji boricha tezroq unutilishi kerak bo'lgan istaklar haqida to'xtalib, sizga og'riq berish yoki o'zimni kamsitish niyatisiz yozyapman; agar xarakterim uning yozilishini va o'qilishini talab qilmaganida, bu xatni yozish va o'qish talab qiladigan zahmatdan qochish mumkin edi. Shuning uchun e'tiboringizni talab qilayotgan erkinligimni kechirishingiz kerak; bilaman, tuyg'ularingiz uni istamay beradi, lekin men buni sizning adolatingizdan talab qilaman.

paras.en: “Two offenses of a very different nature, and by no means of equal magnitude, you last night laid to my charge. The first mentioned was, that, regardless of the sentiments of either, I had detached Mr. Bingley from your sister, and the other, that I had, in defiance of various claims, in defiance of honour and humanity, ruined the immediate prosperity and blasted the prospects of Mr. Wickham. Wilfully and wantonly to have thrown off the companion of my youth, the acknowledged favourite of my father, a young man who had scarcely any other dependence than on our patronage, and who had been brought up to expect its exertion, would be a depravity, to which the separation of two young persons, whose affection could be the growth of only a few weeks, could bear no comparison.
paras.uz: Kecha siz menga butunlay boshqa tabiatdagi va umuman teng bo'lmagan ikki gunohni yukladingiz. Birinchi tilga olingani shuki, men ikkalasining tuyg'ularini hisobga olmay, janob Binglini opangizdan ajratganman; ikkinchisi esa, men turli da'volarga zid ravishda, sharaf va insoniylikka zid ravishda janob Uikhemning hozirgi farovonligini barbod qilganman va istiqbolini puchga chiqarganman. Yoshligimning hamrohini, otamning tan olingan sevimlisini, bizning homiyligimizdan boshqa deyarli tayanchi bo'lmagan va uning amalga oshishini kutish ruhida tarbiyalangan yosh yigitni ataylab va beparvolik bilan tashlab ketish shunday buzuqlik bo'lardiki, mehri atigi bir necha haftada paydo bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan ikki yoshning ajralishi u bilan hech qanday taqqoslanishi mumkin emas.

paras.en: But from the severity of that blame which was last night so liberally bestowed, respecting each circumstance, I shall hope to be in the future secured, when the following account of my actions and their motives has been read. If, in the explanation of them, which is due to myself, I am under the necessity of relating feelings which may be offensive to yours, I can only say that I am sorry. The necessity must be obeyed, and further apology would be absurd.
paras.uz: Lekin kecha har bir holat yuzasidan shunchalik saxiylik bilan aytilgan o'sha ayblovning qattiqligidan, umid qilamanki, harakatlarim va ularning sabablari haqidagi quyidagi bayon o'qilgach, kelajakda himoyalanaman. Agar o'zimga tegishli bo'lgan ularni tushuntirishda sizning tuyg'ularingizni ranjitishi mumkin bo'lgan tuyg'ularni aytib berishga majbur bo'lsam, faqat afsusdaman deya olaman. Zaruratga bo'ysunish kerak, qo'shimcha uzr esa bema'nilik bo'lardi.

paras.en: “I had not been long in Hertfordshire, before I saw, in common with others, that Bingley preferred your elder sister to any other young woman in the country. But it was not till the evening of the dance at Netherfield that I had any apprehension of his feeling a serious attachment. I had often seen him in love before. At that ball, while I had the honour of dancing with you, I was first made acquainted, by Sir William Lucas's accidental information, that Bingley's attentions to your sister had given rise to a general expectation of their marriage. He spoke of it as a certain event, of which the time alone could be undecided. From that moment I observed my friend's behaviour attentively; and I could then perceive that his partiality for Miss Bennet was beyond what I had ever witnessed in him. Your sister I also watched.
paras.uz: Xertfordshirda ko'p bo'lmasimdan, men boshqalar qatori Bingli opangizni bu yerlardagi boshqa har qanday yosh ayoldan afzal ko'rishini ko'rdim. Lekin Nezerfilddagi raqs oqshomigacha uning jiddiy mehr his qilayotganidan hech qanday xavotirim yo'q edi. Men uni ilgari ko'p marta oshiq bo'lganini ko'rganman. O'sha balda, siz bilan raqs tushish sharafiga muyassar bo'lganimda, ser Uilyam Lukasning tasodifiy xabari orqali birinchi marta Binglining opangizga e'tiborlari ularning nikohi haqida umumiy kutishga sabab bo'lganini bildim. U bu haqda faqat vaqti hal bo'lmagan aniq voqea sifatida gapirdi. Shu lahzadan boshlab do'stimning xatti-harakatini diqqat bilan kuzatdim; va shunda uning miss Bennetga moyilligi men undan ilgari ko'rgan har qanday narsadan ortiq ekanini sezdim. Opangizni ham kuzatdim.

paras.en: Her look and manners were open, cheerful, and engaging as ever, but without any symptom of peculiar regard, and I remained convinced from the evening's scrutiny, that though she received his attentions with pleasure, she did not invite them by any participation of sentiment. If you have not been mistaken here, I must have been in error. Your superior knowledge of your sister must make the latter probable. If it be so, if I have been misled by such error to inflict pain on her, your resentment has not been unreasonable. But I shall not scruple to assert, that the serenity of your sister's countenance and air was such as might have given the most acute observer a conviction that, however amiable her temper, her heart was not likely to be easily touched.
paras.uz: Uning qarashi va muomalasi har doimgidek ochiq, quvnoq va jozibali edi, lekin alohida mehrning hech qanday alomatisiz va men o'sha oqshomgi kuzatuvdan u uning e'tiborlarini zavq bilan qabul qilsa ham, ularni tuyg'ularda ishtirok etish bilan chorlamaydi, degan ishonchda qoldim. Agar siz bu yerda adashmagan bo'lsangiz, demak men xato qilgan bo'lsam kerak. Opangizni yaxshiroq bilishingiz ikkinchisini ehtimolli qilishi kerak. Agar shunday bo'lsa, agar men bunday xato bilan chalg'ib, unga og'riq yetkazgan bo'lsam, sizning g'azabingiz asossiz bo'lmagan. Lekin shuni ta'kidlashdan tortinmayman: opangizning chehrasi va qiyofasidagi osoyishtalik shunday ediki, eng o'tkir kuzatuvchiga ham uning fe'li qanchalik yoqimli bo'lmasin, qalbiga oson ta'sir qilib bo'lmasligiga ishonch uyg'otishi mumkin edi.

paras.en: That I was desirous of believing her indifferent is certain--but I will venture to say that my investigation and decisions are not usually influenced by my hopes or fears. I did not believe her to be indifferent because I wished it; I believed it on impartial conviction, as truly as I wished it in reason. My objections to the marriage were not merely those which I last night acknowledged to have the utmost force of passion to put aside, in my own case; the want of connection could not be so great an evil to my friend as to me. But there were other causes of repugnance; causes which, though still existing, and existing to an equal degree in both instances, I had myself endeavoured to forget, because they were not immediately before me. These causes must be stated, though briefly.
paras.uz: Uni befarq deb ishonishni istaganim aniq — lekin aytishga jur'at qilamanki, tekshiruvlarim va qarorlarimga odatda umidlarim yoki qo'rquvlarim ta'sir qilmaydi. Men uni xohlaganim uchun befarq deb ishonmadim; men bunga xolis ishonch asosida, aqlan xohlaganimdek chinakam ishondim. Nikohga qarshi e'tirozlarim kecha o'z holatimda chetga surish uchun ehtirosning eng katta kuchini talab qilishini tan olgan e'tirozlardangina iborat emasdi; qarindoshlik aloqalarining yetishmasligi do'stim uchun men uchun bo'lganidek katta yomonlik bo'la olmasdi. Lekin jirkanishning boshqa sabablari ham bor edi; garchi ular hali ham mavjud bo'lsa va ikkala holatda ham teng darajada mavjud bo'lsa ham, ular darhol ko'z oldimda bo'lmagani uchun o'zim unutishga harakat qilgan sabablar. Bu sabablarni, qisqacha bo'lsa ham, bayon qilish kerak.

paras.en: The situation of your mother's family, though objectionable, was nothing in comparison to that total want of propriety so frequently, so almost uniformly betrayed by herself, by your three younger sisters, and occasionally even by your father. Pardon me. It pains me to offend you. But amidst your concern for the defects of your nearest relations, and your displeasure at this representation of them, let it give you consolation to consider that, to have conducted yourselves so as to avoid any share of the like censure, is praise no less generally bestowed on you and your elder sister, than it is honourable to the sense and disposition of both. I will only say farther that from what passed that evening, my opinion of all parties was confirmed, and every inducement heightened which could have led me before, to preserve my friend from what I esteemed a most unhappy connection.
paras.uz: Onangiz oilasining ahvoli, e'tirozli bo'lsa ham, uning o'zi, uchta kichik opa-singlingiz va vaqti-vaqti bilan hatto otangiz tomonidan juda tez-tez, deyarli doimiy namoyon bo'ladigan odobning butunlay yo'qligi oldida hech narsa emasdi. Kechiring. Sizni ranjitish menga og'riq beradi. Lekin eng yaqin qarindoshlaringizning kamchiliklari uchun tashvishingiz va ularning bunday tasvirlanishidan noroziligingiz orasida shuni o'ylash sizga taskin bersinki, o'zingizni bunday tanbehning hech qanday ulushidan qochadigan tarzda tutganingiz sizga va opangizga umumiy beriladigan maqtov bo'lib, ikkalangizning aqlingiz va fe'lingiz uchun sharaf hamdir. Faqat shuni qo'shimcha aytamanki, o'sha oqshom bo'lib o'tgan voqealardan barcha tomonlar haqidagi fikrim tasdiqlandi va meni avval ham do'stimni men eng baxtsiz deb hisoblagan qarindoshlikdan saqlashga undashi mumkin bo'lgan har bir sabab kuchaydi.

paras.en: He left Netherfield for London, on the day following, as you, I am certain, remember, with the design of soon returning.
paras.uz: Ishonchim komilki, esingizda bo'lsa, u ertasi kuni tez orada qaytish niyatida Nezerfilddan Londonga jo'nab ketdi.

paras.en: “The part which I acted is now to be explained. His sisters' uneasiness had been equally excited with my own; our coincidence of feeling was soon discovered, and, alike sensible that no time was to be lost in detaching their brother, we shortly resolved on joining him directly in London. We accordingly went--and there I readily engaged in the office of pointing out to my friend the certain evils of such a choice. I described, and enforced them earnestly. But, however this remonstrance might have staggered or delayed his determination, I do not suppose that it would ultimately have prevented the marriage, had it not been seconded by the assurance that I hesitated not in giving, of your sister's indifference. He had before believed her to return his affection with sincere, if not with equal regard.
paras.uz: Endi men o'ynagan rolni tushuntirish kerak. Uning opa-singillarining bezovtaligi ham mening bezovtaligim kabi qo'zg'algan edi; tuyg'ularimizning mos kelishi tez orada aniqlandi va akalarini ajratishda vaqt yo'qotmaslik kerakligini birdek his qilib, tez orada darhol Londonda unga qo'shilishga qaror qildik. Shunga ko'ra biz bordik — va u yerda men do'stimga bunday tanlovning aniq yomonliklarini ko'rsatish vazifasini tayyorlik bilan o'z zimmamga oldim. Men ularni tasvirladim va jiddiy ta'kidladim. Lekin bu da'vat uning qarorini qanchalik chayqatgan yoki kechiktirgan bo'lmasin, agar men ikkilanmay bergan opangizning befarqligi haqidagi ishontirish bilan qo'llab-quvvatlanmaganida, oxir-oqibat nikohning oldini olgan bo'lardi, deb o'ylamayman. U ilgari opangiz uning mehriga teng bo'lmasa ham samimiy hurmat bilan javob beradi deb ishongan edi.

paras.en: But Bingley has great natural modesty, with a stronger dependence on my judgement than on his own. To convince him, therefore, that he had deceived himself, was no very difficult point. To persuade him against returning into Hertfordshire, when that conviction had been given, was scarcely the work of a moment. I cannot blame myself for having done thus much. There is but one part of my conduct in the whole affair on which I do not reflect with satisfaction; it is that I condescended to adopt the measures of art so far as to conceal from him your sister's being in town. I knew it myself, as it was known to Miss Bingley; but her brother is even yet ignorant of it.
paras.uz: Lekin Binglining tabiiy kamtarligi katta va u o'z mulohazasidan ko'ra mening mulohazamga ko'proq tayanadi. Shuning uchun uni o'zini aldaganiga ishontirish unchalik qiyin emasdi. Bu ishonch berilgach, uni Xertfordshirga qaytmaslikka ko'ndirish bir lahzalik ish ham emasdi. Shuncha narsani qilganim uchun o'zimni ayblay olmayman. Butun ishdagi xatti-harakatimning faqat bir qismi borki, uni mamnuniyat bilan eslamayman; bu shuki, men opangizning Londonda ekanini undan yashirish darajasida hiyla choralariga tushishga ijozat berdim. Men buni miss Bingli bilgani kabi bilardim; lekin uning akasi hali ham bundan bexabar.

paras.en: That they might have met without ill consequence is perhaps probable; but his regard did not appear to me enough extinguished for him to see her without some danger. Perhaps this concealment, this disguise was beneath me; it is done, however, and it was done for the best. On this subject I have nothing more to say, no other apology to offer. If I have wounded your sister's feelings, it was unknowingly done and though the motives which governed me may to you very naturally appear insufficient, I have not yet learnt to condemn them.
paras.uz: Ular yomon oqibatsiz uchrashishi mumkin edi, bu, ehtimol, haqiqatga yaqindir; lekin uning mehri uni biroz xavfsiz ko'ra olishi uchun yetarlicha so'ngandek menga ko'rinmadi. Ehtimol, bu yashirish, bu niqoblanish mendan past ish edi; biroq u qilindi va yaxshilik uchun qilindi. Bu mavzuda boshqa aytadigan gapim, taklif qiladigan boshqa uzrim yo'q. Agar opangizning tuyg'ularini yaralagan bo'lsam, bu bilmagan holda qilingan va meni boshqargan sabablar sizga juda tabiiy ravishda yetarli emasdek ko'rinsa ham, men ularni hali qoralashni o'rganmaganman.

paras.en: “With respect to that other, more weighty accusation, of having injured Mr. Wickham, I can only refute it by laying before you the whole of his connection with my family. Of what he has particularly accused me I am ignorant; but of the truth of what I shall relate, I can summon more than one witness of undoubted veracity.
paras.uz: Janob Uikhemga zarar yetkazganim haqidagi boshqa, og'irroq ayblovga kelsak, uni faqat uning oilam bilan butun aloqasini sizning oldingizga qo'yish orqali rad eta olaman. U meni aynan nimada ayblaganini bilmayman; lekin aytib beradiganlarimning haqiqatligi uchun shubhasiz rostgo'y bo'lgan bir nechta guvohni chaqira olaman.

paras.en: “Mr. Wickham is the son of a very respectable man, who had for many years the management of all the Pemberley estates, and whose good conduct in the discharge of his trust naturally inclined my father to be of service to him; and on George Wickham, who was his godson, his kindness was therefore liberally bestowed. My father supported him at school, and afterwards at Cambridge--most important assistance, as his own father, always poor from the extravagance of his wife, would have been unable to give him a gentleman's education. My father was not only fond of this young man's society, whose manners were always engaging; he had also the highest opinion of him, and hoping the church would be his profession, intended to provide for him in it. As for myself, it is many, many years since I first began to think of him in a very different manner.
paras.uz: Janob Uikhem ko'p yillar davomida Pemberlining barcha mulklarini boshqargan juda hurmatli odamning o'g'li; uning ishonchli vazifani bajarishdagi yaxshi xulqi otamni tabiiy ravishda unga xizmat qilishga moyil qildi; shuning uchun uning cho'qintirgan o'g'li bo'lgan Jorj Uikhemga uning mehribonligi saxiylik bilan ko'rsatildi. Otam uni maktabda, keyin esa Kembrijda ta'minladi — bu juda muhim yordam edi, chunki o'z otasi xotinining isrofgarchiligi tufayli doim kambag'al bo'lib, unga janoblarga xos ta'lim bera olmasdi. Otam nafaqat muomalasi doim jozibali bo'lgan bu yosh yigitning davrasini yaxshi ko'rardi; u u haqida eng yuqori fikrda ham edi va cherkov uning kasbi bo'lishiga umid qilib, unda uni ta'minlashni niyat qilgan edi. Menga kelsak, u haqida butunlay boshqacha o'ylay boshlaganimga ko'p, ko'p yillar bo'ldi.

paras.en: The vicious propensities--the want of principle, which he was careful to guard from the knowledge of his best friend, could not escape the observation of a young man of nearly the same age with himself, and who had opportunities of seeing him in unguarded moments, which Mr. Darcy could not have. Here again I shall give you pain--to what degree you only can tell. But whatever may be the sentiments which Mr. Wickham has created, a suspicion of their nature shall not prevent me from unfolding his real character--it adds even another motive.
paras.uz: U eng yaxshi do'stining bilishidan ehtiyotkorlik bilan yashirgan yomon moyilliklari — tamoyillarning yo'qligi o'zi bilan deyarli tengdosh bo'lgan va uni janob Darsi ko'ra olmaydigan ehtiyotsiz lahzalarda ko'rish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lgan yosh yigitning nazaridan chetda qola olmadi. Bu yerda yana sizga og'riq beraman — qanchalik darajada, buni faqat siz ayta olasiz. Lekin janob Uikhem qanday tuyg'ular uyg'otgan bo'lmasin, ularning tabiati haqidagi gumon meni uning haqiqiy xarakterini ochib berishdan to'xtata olmaydi — aksincha, bu yana bir sabab qo'shadi.

paras.en: “My excellent father died about five years ago; and his attachment to Mr. Wickham was to the last so steady, that in his will he particularly recommended it to me, to promote his advancement in the best manner that his profession might allow--and if he took orders, desired that a valuable family living might be his as soon as it became vacant. There was also a legacy of one thousand pounds. His own father did not long survive mine, and within half a year from these events, Mr. Wickham wrote to inform me that, having finally resolved against taking orders, he hoped I should not think it unreasonable for him to expect some more immediate pecuniary advantage, in lieu of the preferment, by which he could not be benefited.
paras.uz: Ajoyib otam taxminan besh yil oldin vafot etdi; uning janob Uikhemga bog'liqligi oxirigacha shunchalik barqaror ediki, vasiyatnomasida u menga uning kasbi imkon bergan eng yaxshi tarzda uning yuksalishiga ko'maklashishni alohida tavsiya qildi — va agar u ruhoniylikni qabul qilsa, qimmatli oilaviy lavozim bo'shashi bilanoq uniki bo'lishini istadi. Shuningdek, ming funt meros ham bor edi. Uning o'z otasi menikidan ko'p o'tmay vafot etdi va bu voqealardan yarim yil ichida janob Uikhem menga xat yozib, ruhoniylikni qabul qilmaslikka nihoyat qaror qilgani uchun, undan foyda ko'ra olmaydigan lavozim o'rniga biroz darhol pul manfaati kutishini asossiz deb hisoblamasligimga umid qilishini bildirdi.

paras.en: He had some intention, he added, of studying law, and I must be aware that the interest of one thousand pounds would be a very insufficient support therein. I rather wished, than believed him to be sincere; but, at any rate, was perfectly ready to accede to his proposal. I knew that Mr. Wickham ought not to be a clergyman; the business was therefore soon settled--he resigned all claim to assistance in the church, were it possible that he could ever be in a situation to receive it, and accepted in return three thousand pounds. All connection between us seemed now dissolved. I thought too ill of him to invite him to Pemberley, or admit his society in town.
paras.uz: Uning qo'shimcha qilishicha, huquqni o'rganish niyati bor edi va men ming funtning foizi bunda juda yetarsiz tayanch bo'lishini bilishim kerak edi. Men uning samimiyligiga ishonishdan ko'ra ko'proq istardim; lekin har holda uning taklifiga rozi bo'lishga to'liq tayyor edim. Janob Uikhem ruhoniy bo'lmasligi kerakligini bilardim; shuning uchun ish tez hal bo'ldi — u, agar qachondir uni olish holatida bo'lishi mumkin bo'lsa, cherkovdagi yordamga bo'lgan barcha da'volaridan voz kechdi va evaziga uch ming funt qabul qildi. Endi oramizdagi barcha aloqalar uzilganday tuyuldi. Men u haqida uni Pemberliga taklif qilish yoki Londonda uning davrasini qabul qilish uchun haddan tashqari yomon o'ylardim.

paras.en: In town I believe he chiefly lived, but his studying the law was a mere pretence, and being now free from all restraint, his life was a life of idleness and dissipation. For about three years I heard little of him; but on the decease of the incumbent of the living which had been designed for him, he applied to me again by letter for the presentation. His circumstances, he assured me, and I had no difficulty in believing it, were exceedingly bad. He had found the law a most unprofitable study, and was now absolutely resolved on being ordained, if I would present him to the living in question--of which he trusted there could be little doubt, as he was well assured that I had no other person to provide for, and I could not have forgotten my revered father's intentions.
paras.uz: Ishonamanki, u asosan Londonda yashagan, lekin uning huquqni o'rganishi shunchaki bahona edi va endi har qanday cheklovdan ozod bo'lib, uning hayoti bekorchilik va buzuqlik hayoti edi. Taxminan uch yil davomida u haqida kam eshitdim; lekin uning uchun mo'ljallangan lavozimdagi ruhoniy vafot etgach, u yana xat bilan menga tayinlov so'rab murojaat qildi. Uning ishontirishicha, ahvoli nihoyatda yomon edi, bunga ishonishda menda hech qanday qiyinchilik yo'q edi. U huquqni juda foydasiz o'qish deb topgan va endi agar men uni o'sha lavozimga tayinlasam, ruhoniylikka o'tishga mutlaqo qaror qilgan edi — bunga u kam shubha bo'lishi mumkin deb ishonardi, chunki menda ta'minlashim kerak bo'lgan boshqa odam yo'qligiga yaxshi amin edi va men muhtaram otamning niyatlarini unutgan bo'lishim mumkin emasdi.

paras.en: You will hardly blame me for refusing to comply with this entreaty, or for resisting every repetition to it. His resentment was in proportion to the distress of his circumstances--and he was doubtless as violent in his abuse of me to others as in his reproaches to myself. After this period every appearance of acquaintance was dropped. How he lived I know not. But last summer he was again most painfully obtruded on my notice.
paras.uz: Bu iltimosni bajarishdan bosh tortganim yoki uning har bir takrorlanishiga qarshilik qilganim uchun meni ayblamasangiz kerak. Uning g'azabi ahvolining og'irligiga mutanosib edi — va u, shubhasiz, boshqalarga meni haqorat qilishda menga qilgan ta'nalaridagi kabi qattiqqo'l edi. Shu davrdan keyin tanishlikning har qanday ko'rinishi to'xtatildi. U qanday yashaganini bilmayman. Lekin o'tgan yozda u yana eng og'riqli tarzda e'tiborimga majburan kirib keldi.

paras.en: “I must now mention a circumstance which I would wish to forget myself, and which no obligation less than the present should induce me to unfold to any human being. Having said thus much, I feel no doubt of your secrecy. My sister, who is more than ten years my junior, was left to the guardianship of my mother's nephew, Colonel Fitzwilliam, and myself.
paras.uz: Endi men o'zim unutishni istaydigan va hozirgidan kam bo'lmagan hech qanday majburiyat meni biror insonga ochib berishga undamasligi kerak bo'lgan holatni tilga olishim kerak. Shuncha narsani aytib, sir saqlashingizga hech qanday shubham yo'q. Mendan o'n yoshdan ortiq kichik bo'lgan singlim onamning jiyani polkovnik Fitsuilyam va mening vasiyligimga qoldirilgan.

paras.en: About a year ago, she was taken from school, and an establishment formed for her in London; and last summer she went with the lady who presided over it, to Ramsgate; and thither also went Mr. Wickham, undoubtedly by design; for there proved to have been a prior acquaintance between him and Mrs. Younge, in whose character we were most unhappily deceived; and by her connivance and aid, he so far recommended himself to Georgiana, whose affectionate heart retained a strong impression of his kindness to her as a child, that she was persuaded to believe herself in love, and to consent to an elopement. She was then but fifteen, which must be her excuse; and after stating her imprudence, I am happy to add, that I owed the knowledge of it to herself.
paras.uz: Taxminan bir yil oldin uni maktabdan olishdi va unga Londonda uy tashkil qilindi; o'tgan yozda u unga boshchilik qilgan xonim bilan Ramsgeytga bordi; u yerga janob Uikhem ham bordi, shubhasiz, ataylab; chunki u bilan biz xarakterida juda baxtsizlarcha aldangan missis Yang o'rtasida oldindan tanishlik bo'lgani ma'lum bo'ldi; va uning til biriktirishi va yordami bilan u mehribon qalbi bolaligida unga ko'rsatgan mehribonligi haqida kuchli taassurotni saqlagan Jorjianaga o'zini shunchalik yoqtirdiki, uni o'zini oshiq deb ishonishga va qochishga rozi bo'lishga ko'ndirdi. U o'shanda atigi o'n besh yoshda edi, bu uning uzri bo'lishi kerak; uning ehtiyotsizligini aytib bo'lgach, buni uning o'zidan bilganimni qo'shishdan xursandman.

paras.en: I joined them unexpectedly a day or two before the intended elopement, and then Georgiana, unable to support the idea of grieving and offending a brother whom she almost looked up to as a father, acknowledged the whole to me. You may imagine what I felt and how I acted. Regard for my sister's credit and feelings prevented any public exposure; but I wrote to Mr. Wickham, who left the place immediately, and Mrs. Younge was of course removed from her charge. Mr. Wickham's chief object was unquestionably my sister's fortune, which is thirty thousand pounds; but I cannot help supposing that the hope of revenging himself on me was a strong inducement. His revenge would have been complete indeed.
paras.uz: Rejalashtirilgan qochishdan bir-ikki kun oldin men kutilmaganda ularning oldiga bordim va shunda deyarli ota kabi qaraydigan akasini qayg'uga solish va ranjitish fikriga chiday olmagan Jorjiana menga hammasini tan oldi. Nimani his qilganimni va qanday harakat qilganimni tasavvur qilishingiz mumkin. Singlimning obro'si va tuyg'ularini hurmat qilish har qanday ommaviy fosh qilishning oldini oldi; lekin men janob Uikhemga xat yozdim, u darhol joyni tark etdi, missis Yang esa, albatta, vazifasidan chetlashtirildi. Janob Uikhemning asosiy maqsadi, shubhasiz, singlimning o'ttiz ming funtlik boyligi edi; lekin mendan qasos olish umidi ham kuchli turtki bo'lgan deb taxmin qilmasdan ilojim yo'q. Uning qasosi haqiqatan ham to'liq bo'lardi.

paras.en: “This, madam, is a faithful narrative of every event in which we have been concerned together; and if you do not absolutely reject it as false, you will, I hope, acquit me henceforth of cruelty towards Mr. Wickham. I know not in what manner, under what form of falsehood he had imposed on you; but his success is not perhaps to be wondered at. Ignorant as you previously were of everything concerning either, detection could not be in your power, and suspicion certainly not in your inclination.
paras.uz: Bu, xonim, biz birga ishtirok etgan har bir voqeaning sodiq hikoyasi; agar uni yolg'on deb mutlaqo rad etmasangiz, umid qilamanki, bundan buyon meni janob Uikhemga nisbatan shafqatsizlikda ayblamaysiz. U sizni qanday tarzda, qanday yolg'on shaklida aldaganini bilmayman; lekin uning muvaffaqiyati, ehtimol, ajablanarli emasdir. Ilgari ikkalasiga oid hamma narsadan bexabar bo'lganingiz uchun fosh qilish qo'lingizdan kelmasdi, shubha esa, albatta, moyilligingizda yo'q edi.

paras.en: “You may possibly wonder why all this was not told you last night; but I was not then master enough of myself to know what could or ought to be revealed. For the truth of everything here related, I can appeal more particularly to the testimony of Colonel Fitzwilliam, who, from our near relationship and constant intimacy, and, still more, as one of the executors of my father's will, has been unavoidably acquainted with every particular of these transactions. If your abhorrence of me should make my assertions valueless, you cannot be prevented by the same cause from confiding in my cousin; and that there may be the possibility of consulting him, I shall endeavour to find some opportunity of putting this letter in your hands in the course of the morning. I will only add, God bless you.
paras.uz: Ehtimol, bularning hammasi kecha nega sizga aytilmaganiga hayron bo'larsiz; lekin o'shanda nima oshkor qilinishi mumkin yoki kerakligini bilish uchun o'zimga yetarlicha hokim emasdim. Bu yerda aytilgan hamma narsaning haqiqatligi uchun ayniqsa polkovnik Fitsuilyamning guvohligiga murojaat qila olaman, u yaqin qarindoshligimiz va doimiy yaqinligimiz tufayli, undan ham ko'ra otamning vasiyatnomasi ijrochilaridan biri sifatida bu ishlarning har bir tafsilotidan muqarrar ravishda xabardor bo'lgan. Agar mendan nafratingiz da'volarimni qadrsiz qilsa, xuddi shu sabab amakivachchamga ishonishingizga to'sqinlik qila olmaydi; u bilan maslahatlashish imkoniyati bo'lishi uchun, bugun ertalab bu xatni qo'lingizga topshirish uchun biror imkoniyat topishga harakat qilaman. Faqat shuni qo'shaman: Xudo sizni asrasin.

paras.en: “FITZWILLIAM DARCY”
paras.uz: FITSUILYAM DARSI»
